title: Sr. Dental Insurance and Verification Expert
description:
About the job Location - Remote



Overview



Dentistry Automation helps US dental practices automate insurance verification, claims, payment posting, and patient recall. We're growing our RCM client base and need someone to own client onboarding end to end — getting new clients fully live, fast — reporting directly to our Head of RCM.



Job Responsibilities -



Collect and set up payer portal access for each new client; complete payer/clearinghouse enrollment (EDI, ERA, EFT) where required

Install and configure our software and connect it to the client's practice management system (Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, Denticon, Curve, MacPractice, SoftDent, Cloud 9, and others)

Configure each client's RCM workflow — eligibility verification, claims, payment posting, recall — to our standard process

Run onboarding calls with client front-office staff to gather information, walk through setup, and resolve issues

Keep onboarding status current and flag delays immediately

Confirm a client is fully live — claims flowing, payments posting — before handoff to ongoing RCM operations



Must have -



1-2+ years of experience in dental billing, RCM, and insurance verification, candidates without dental experience will not be considered for the role

Comfortable making outbound calls to US dental offices and insurance payers

Working knowledge of payer portals, claims, and EOBs

Clear spoken English and a professional phone manner

Highly organized — able to run several client onboardings in parallel without dropping anything



Nice to have -



Dental-specific RCM experience

Experience with EDI or clearinghouse enrollment

Familiarity with Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or Denticon

AAPC/CPC or similar billing certification



Time Zone -



This role works in US business hours overlap, with shift coverage through 2:00 PM US Central Time, to be reachable for client and payer calls during the US workday.

title: Architect VA – UK Planning & 2D/3D Design | Remote
description:
Please follow the application instructions below



About PropFix.ie



PropFix.ie is Ireland's trusted property maintenance specialist, offering comprehensive solutions with years of expertise across the construction and renovation sectors. We transform spaces through our diverse range of services, from handyman solutions and office fit-outs to complete renovations, house extensions, and specialized installations including doors, floors, and partitions.



Our commitment to delivering the best value property maintenance has established us as a reliable partner for residential and commercial clients nationwide. With decades of experience, including 50 years of expertise in garage conversions, we pride ourselves on impeccable craftsmanship, turning our clients' visions into reality while ensuring their properties remain in top condition.



Role Overview

We are seeking a skilled and versatile Architect Virtual Assistant to join our dynamic team. This multifaceted role combines architectural design expertise with comprehensive project support and administrative management. The successful candidate will provide essential drafting services, create detailed 3D models and visualizations, while also managing project coordination, supplier relationships, and administrative tasks to ensure seamless project delivery from concept to completion.



Key Responsibilities

Architectural Design & Drafting



Drafting Services: Prepare precise architectural drawings and technical documentation for construction projects

3D Modeling: Create detailed 3D models using Revit, AutoCAD, and SketchUp software

Video Walkthroughs: Develop engaging 3D video walkthroughs and visualizations for client presentations

Detailed Drawings: Produce comprehensive construction drawings, plans, and technical specifications

Design Support: Assist with design development and modification throughout project lifecycle



Project Management & Coordination



Project Scheduling: Manage project timelines, milestones, and delivery schedules

Team Management: Coordinate and oversee subcontractors and in-house employees

Progress Monitoring: Track project progress and ensure adherence to schedules and quality standards

Resource Planning: Coordinate project resources and workflow optimization



Supplier & Procurement Management



Supplier Coordination: Manage relationships with suppliers and vendors

Procurement Support: Assist with material sourcing, ordering, and delivery coordination

Cost Management: Support procurement processes and maintain supplier databases

Quality Control: Ensure materials and services meet project specifications and standards



Administrative & CRM Support



CRM Management: Maintain and update customer relationship management systems with project and client information

 Management: Handle professional
 correspondence and client communications

General Administration: Perform various administrative tasks to support daily operations

Ad Hoc Tasks: Flexibly handle diverse project-related tasks as required by the business



Required Skills & Experience

Technical Requirements



CAD Proficiency: Advanced skills in Archicad, Revit, AutoCAD, and SketchUp for architectural design and 3D modeling

Architectural Knowledge: Strong understanding of architectural principles, construction methods, and building standards

Visualization Skills: Experience creating 3D renderings, video walkthroughs, and presentation materials

Technical Drawing: Proficiency in producing detailed construction drawings and technical specifications



Project Management Skills



Coordination Experience: Proven ability to manage multiple projects and coordinate with various stakeholders

Team Leadership: Experience managing subcontractors, suppliers, and team members

Scheduling: Strong organizational skills with experience in project scheduling and timeline management

Problem-Solving: Analytical thinking and ability to resolve project challenges efficiently



Administrative & Technology Skills



CRM Systems: Experience with customer relationship management platforms and databases

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for client and contractor liaison

Software Proficiency: Competency in Microsoft Office Suite, project management software, and administrative tools

Multitasking: Ability to handle diverse tasks and adapt to changing project requirements



Professional Qualifications



Education: Degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field preferred

Industry Experience: Previous experience in architectural practice, construction, or property development

Virtual Assistance: Experience working remotely and managing virtual project coordination



What We Offer



Competitive salary package

Opportunity to work on diverse architectural and construction projects

Professional development and training opportunities

Collaborative and supportive remote work environment

Career growth potential within an expanding company

Involvement in challenging projects across Ireland's property maintenance and construction sector

Remote working flexibility with comprehensive project support systems

Exposure to cutting-edge architectural technologies and design processes



Application Reminders



To help optimize your application and improve its visibility during our screening process, please make sure to follow the instructions below. A complete and well-structured application may increase your chances of being considered for the role.



Submit your updated CV and portfolio (if applicable). Please ensure both documents are current and highlight your most relevant skills and work experience.



Include any international or remote work experience in your employment history, if applicable. If you do not have foreign or remote work experience, that's completely fine—we still encourage you to apply.



List all software, tools, and platforms you are proficient in. Be sure to include all relevant applications and technologies you have experience using so we can better assess your qualifications against the role requirements.



Application Instructions: 

Please complete the attached application form and submit it along with your CV: 



Thank you, and we look forward to reviewing your application!

The Role



We need one senior marketer who owns Amazon PPC, listings, and Shopify DTC marketing end to end — not a manager, not an agency liaison. You do the work yourself, and you use AI daily to do it faster and better than a traditional workflow allows.



This is an individual contributor role for someone who wants to run the whole show, not delegate pieces of it.



What You'll Own

Amazon PPC — build and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display; manage ACOS/TACOS weekly with AI-assisted search term analysis

Listings & A+ Content — write and structure titles, bullets, backend keywords, and A+ Content using AI + Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Black Box)

Shopify — product listings and DTC marketing (Google Ads, Meta Ads)

Reporting — weekly performance reporting across channels, with proactive optimization, not just recaps

Must-Haves

2+ years managing Amazon PPC campaigns independently

Hands-on Helium 10 experience

1+ year Shopify DTC marketing, including Google Ads and Meta Ads

Daily use of Claude or ChatGPT as part of your actual workflow

Strong written English — content goes live under the brand name

Comfortable reading and acting on campaign data without hand-holding

Nice-to-Haves

Klaviyo or similar ESP experience

Experience with 2-3 other AI tools beyond Claude/ChatGPT (Helium 10's AI features, Midjourney, Jasper, etc.)

New-brand or new-product launch experience specifically (vs. established catalogs)

Send:



Resume

2-3 sentences on the most recent Amazon or Shopify launch you ran, and what you'd do differently

Your salary expectation (a range is fine)

One quick AI proof-of-skill: an AI-written Amazon title + 3 bullets for any product of your choosing, with the prompt you used



That's it for the first pass. If it's a fit, we'll move to a short unpaid test task — a real PPC plan and AI-assisted search term analysis — before any offer.

title: Junior Property Manager (US Residential Real Estate - Remote)
description:
We are a growing US residential real estate company managing properties in Iowa, and we are looking for a Junior Property Manager to help run day-to-day property operations remotely.



This is not a purely administrative position. You will work closely with our property management team, maintenance crew, leasing team, and tenants to make sure issues are followed through from start to finish.



We are looking for someone who is organized, proactive, comfortable following up repeatedly, and willing to take ownership when something is not getting done.



* What You’ll Do



- Manage and respond to tenant inquiries through
, phone, and property management systems

- Coordinate maintenance requests with tenants and our on-site maintenance team

- Track open work orders and follow up until issues are fully resolved

- Support leasing activities, including inquiries, applications, move-ins, renewals, and move-outs

- Coordinate unit turns and make sure apartments are ready before new tenants arrive

- Maintain accurate records in our property management software

- Follow up with contractors, maintenance staff, tenants, and internal team members when information or action is outstanding

- Identify overdue or unresolved issues and escalate them to management

- Help keep management informed of what is happening across the portfolio

- Support other property management and operations tasks as needed



* What We’re Looking For



Required:



- Strong written and spoken English

- Excellent organization and follow-through

- Comfortable communicating directly with US tenants and vendors

- Able to handle multiple open issues without losing track of details

- Confident following up with people rather than simply waiting for responses

- Good judgment about when an issue needs to be escalated

- Comfortable working during US Central Time business hours

- Reliable internet connection and suitable remote working environment



Preferred:



- Experience in US property management, real estate, leasing, maintenance coordination, or tenant support

- Experience with property management software such as AppFolio, Rent Manager, Buildium, or similar

- Experience working with maintenance teams or contractors

-Previous experience supporting a US-based company



* What Success Looks Like



A good Junior Property Manager does more than pass messages between people.



If a tenant reports a leak, for example, we expect you to know:



What happened → Who is responsible → What is the next action → When should it happen → Has it actually been completed?



You should enjoy bringing structure to situations where several people are involved and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



* Who Will Do Well Here



You will probably enjoy this role if you:



- Naturally make lists and keep track of unfinished items

- Don't mind reminding someone two or three times when necessary

- Ask questions when something does not make sense

- Take responsibility for getting an answer rather than saying, “I already sent them a message”

- Can be friendly with tenants while still being firm and professional

- Want to develop into a full Property Manager over time



There is room for increased responsibility as you learn our portfolio and demonstrate that you can independently manage day-to-day property operations.



* How to Apply



Please send us:

- A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience

- Your experience with US property management, if any

- Property management systems or software you have used

- Your availability to work US Central Time

- A short answer to the following scenario: A tenant reported that their air conditioning is not working. You messaged the maintenance technician yesterday, but the technician has not replied and the tenant is now following up again. What would you do next?



Please begin your application with the words “Junior PM – Iowa” so we know you have read the full posting.

title: Medical Partnerships and Admin Coordinator
description:
Healthcare Partnerships & Administration Coordinator



About DOC on Call



DOC is a growing Australian digital health platform connecting patients with doctors, specialists and allied-health professionals through telehealth and hybrid healthcare services.



As we expand our practitioner network and develop our physical health hubs, we are looking for a proactive, organised and confident team member to support our partnerships and daily operations.



## About the Role



You will work directly with the Co-Founder and become an important extension of the leadership team.



This is not a traditional sales position. It is a relationship-focused coordination and administration role involving communication with healthcare professionals and organisations across Australia.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Researching potential healthcare partners and practitioners

- Contacting medical practices, pharmacies, doctors and allied-health providers by telephone and

- Introducing DOC and explaining our practitioner network

- Scheduling meetings and interviews for the Co-Founder

- Managing contacts, tasks and follow-ups through our CRM

- Assisting with the onboarding of doctors and health practitioners

- Maintaining accurate practitioner and partnership records

- Preparing
s, documents and basic reports

- Following up on outstanding information and documentation

- Providing general administrative and operational support

- Helping improve our internal processes as the business grows



## About You



You may be a strong fit if you have:



- Experience in healthcare administration, medical support, partnerships, recruitment or a similar environment

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Confidence communicating with doctors, healthcare practitioners and business owners

- A professional and friendly telephone manner

- Strong organisation and attention to detail

- The ability to manage multiple tasks and follow-ups

- A proactive attitude and willingness to take ownership of your work

- Experience using CRM systems, Microsoft Office and Google Workspace

- The ability to work independently in a remote environment

- A reliable computer and internet connection



Experience working with an Australian healthcare organisation would be highly regarded but is not essential.



## What We Offer



- A remote position with a growing Australian healthcare company

- Direct access to and support from the leadership team

- Long-term career and professional-development opportunities

- A supportive and collaborative working environment

- The opportunity to help develop systems and processes from an early stage

- Meaningful work supporting the growth of an innovative healthcare network



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your current résumé

2. A short cover letter explaining why you would be a strong fit for DOC

3. Details of any relevant healthcare, administration, partnership or customer-service experience

4. A brief voice or video introduction, if available



Please begin your application with the words “DOC Partnerships” so we know you have read the complete job advertisement.

title: Executive Assistant to Founder — Business & Personal Operations (AI-First Role)
description:
Remote Worldwide | Full-Time



Working hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time



Compensation: Competitive salary based on experience and location



About the position



I am the founder of Dentistry Automation, a fast-scaling dental technology and revenue-cycle automation company. I also manage investments, properties, frequent travel, and a wide mix of personal and business commitments.



This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role.



This is an AI-augmented Executive Operator role.



You will act as the founder’s second brain + execution engine, using AI tools as your daily co-pilot to think faster, organize better, and execute with precision. If you are not actively using AI (ChatGPT/Claude/etc, automation tools, CRM AI features, workflow agents, etc.) in your daily work, this role is not for you.



We are building a modern, AI-native operating system around the founder — and you are the human layer that makes it real.



This is a hands-on position. You must be comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, handling shifting priorities, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks — with AI helping you move at 10x speed.



Responsibilities -



Executive and personal administration (AI-powered)



* Manage calendar, appointments, reminders, and scheduling using AI-assisted planning tools



* Use AI to detect scheduling conflicts, optimize time blocks, and prepare daily agendas



* Organize domestic and international travel using AI for itinerary building, price comparison, and real-time adjustments



* Maintain a centralized AI-powered task system for commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups



* Convert
s, WhatsApp messages, and voice notes into structured action items using AI transcription and summarization tools



* Use AI research tools to generate fast comparisons, summaries, and decision briefs



* Automate document organization, form filling, and signature workflows wherever possible



* Assist with property, insurance, investment, household, and personal admin using AI-assisted tracking and reminders



* Coordinate with advisors, vendors, attorneys, accountants, and service providers using AI-generated follow-ups and summaries



Dentistry Automation support (AI-native operations) -



* Draft and refine
s using AI (tone, clarity, persuasion, speed)



* Use AI to follow up with prospects, customers, employees, and vendors consistently and intelligently



* Schedule demos, meetings, and internal calls with AI-assisted coordination



* Generate meeting agendas and pre-reads using AI summaries of CRM and
 history



* Update Zoho CRM with AI-generated notes, next steps, and follow-up logic



* Track proposals, invoices, collections, subscriptions, and renewals using AI dashboards and alerts



* Convert meetings into structured action items using AI transcription tools



* Maintain spreadsheets, trackers, and reports with AI-assisted updates and anomaly detection



* Coordinate across sales, operations, HR, finance, and tech using AI summaries instead of manual reporting



* Ensure projects move forward by using AI to identify bottlenecks and missing follow-ups



Daily reporting (AI-generated + human-reviewed)



At the start of each day, provide an AI-assisted briefing:



* Today’s optimized schedule and priorities



* Key decisions required from the founder



* Overdue or at-risk items flagged by AI



* Critical follow-ups generated from CRM/email/notes



* Suggested task execution plan



At the end of each day:



* Work completed (auto-summarized via AI tools)



* Pending items and blockers



* Items waiting on external responses



* Risks or issues flagged by AI



* Next-day priority recommendations



Required qualifications



* Excellent spoken and written English



* Prior experience as Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or Virtual Assistant



* Strong comfort using AI tools daily (ChatGPT, automation tools, CRM AI features, productivity agents, etc.)



* Ability to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time



* Strong organization, execution discipline, and follow-through



* Comfortable making calls, sending follow-ups, and using AI to improve communication quality



* Proficient with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and modern SaaS tools



* Experience or willingness to learn Zoho CRM deeply (including AI features if available)



* High trust level with confidential data (business + personal)



* Reliable computer, high-speed internet, backup internet, and distraction-free workspace



* Strong independent working ability with proactive communication



The right person



You will thrive here if you:



* Use AI as your default thinking partner, not just a tool



* Execute faster because you automate thinking, not just tasks



* Take ownership of outcomes, not just instructions



* Use AI to anticipate problems before they happen



* Communicate clearly, quickly, and proactively



* Stay calm in chaos and structured in ambiguity



* Know how to separate signal from noise using AI filtering



* Think like an operator, not an assistant



Position details



* Full-time, long-term remote role



* Open worldwide



* Fixed working hours: 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time



* Competitive salary based on experience and geography



* Initial paid evaluation period



* Opportunity to grow into a senior AI operations role within the company



How to apply



Please provide:



1. Your résumé



2. A 2-minute video introducing yourself and your experience



3. Your country and time zone



4. Confirmation you can permanently work 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time



5. Salary expectations



6. A short written response to this scenario:



“A founder has two conflicting meetings tomorrow, several unanswered customer
s, an overdue invoice, and an international trip that has not been organized. Explain how you would prioritize and manage this — specifically mentioning how you would use AI tools to execute faster and better.”





Note - Applications missing any of the above will not be considered.

title: SDR (Neutral Accent)
description:
About Us



ToplineX builds B2B revenue growth engines that help companies generate predictable pipeline. We design and run signal-driven outbound systems 
, LinkedIn, and phone) that identify the right accounts, reach them at the right time, and turn them into qualified sales conversations. Our clients range across the B2B spectrum, typically selling high-value or complex offerings where a fast, thoughtful human touch turns interest into booked meetings.



We're looking for an SDR to own the pipeline: every positive reply, inbound lead, and past conversation, turned into held meetings.



What You'll Be Doing



You will work directly with the founder and own everything that happens after a prospect shows interest.



Your responsibilities include:



- Monitoring campaign inboxes and responding to positive replies within 15 minutes during working hours (AI assisted)

- Calling interested prospects to qualify them and get the meeting booked

- Running multi-touch follow-up sequences 
, phone, SMS) over several days with prospects who showed interest but didn't book

- Maximising show rates: confirmations, SMS and
 reminders, and re-engaging no-shows to get them rebooked

- Re-engaging inbound leads, older lists, and people we've spoken to in the past

- Keeping the CRM clean and up to date, with short daily activity updates and weekly pipeline reporting

- Supporting the founder in the sales motion: pre-call research, post-call follow-ups, chasing proposals

- Over time, taking ownership of outreach campaigns and building proactive plays to reach the right people at the right time



Goal: no interested lead ever goes cold. You own the gap between "positive reply" and "meeting held" so the founder can focus on sales calls and strategy.



What Success Looks Like



- Speed to lead: positive replies answered within 15 minutes during working hours

- Meetings booked, and more importantly, meetings held

- Show rate of 80%+ through tight confirmation and reminder sequences

- A pipeline where every lead has a next step and nothing slips through the cracks



Who Is This Role For



This role is perfect for someone who:



- Has worked in an SDR, BDR, or appointment-setting function before

- Is comfortable and confident picking up the phone and speaking to senior, high-value prospects

- Wants ownership and responsibility for the pipeline, not just task execution

- Understands the world of GTM and lead generation (cold
, outbound, how agencies work)

title: Meta Ads Executive
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read below before submitting your application.

In the application form, you'll be required to submit a 2-minute video introduction answering: Who are you, and why do you think you're the best fit for this role?

You'll also be asked a few short written questions. If your video checks out, we'll invite you to interview.

In your application, use the Code: 8000. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.



Our creative and campaign execution directly impacts business growth.

Right now, we need someone who can build ads and quality check them before they ever reach a client account; not someone who uploads and hopes for the best.

We don't need someone who just "gets campaigns live." We need someone who understands that a single missed setting can cost a client real money, and treats every build like it matters.

We're not looking for someone who needs to be told to double-check their own work. We need someone who catches the error before we do.

— Andy Gray, Founder & CEO



WHO WE ARE

The Graygency is a performance marketing agency working with 7–8 figure DTC e-commerce brands across the UK, US, and UAE. We call ourselves Performance Scientists; we're in the P&L, not just the ad account. We're building an agency powered by systems, AI, and commercial thinking, not headcount.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO:

Campaign Build 

- Build Meta, TikTok and snapchat ad campaigns (and other paid social platforms as needed) from strategist briefs: campaign - structure, ad sets, targeting, budgets, creative uploads, copy, and UTM tracking

- Set up campaigns accurately, on spec, and on time, across multiple client accounts

- Follow naming conventions, folder structures, and account hygiene standards without being chased



Quality Control

- QC every campaign and ad before launch against a checklist: targeting, budgets, pixel/events, UTM tagging, ad copy, creative specs, and platform compliance

- Catch and fix errors before they go live, not after they've spent budget

- Own the final check on other people's builds as well as your own

- Flag inconsistencies or risks clearly and early, rather than letting them slide



Process and Support

- Maintain and improve build and QC checklists so quality doesn't depend on memory

- Support Media Strategists and Paid Social Strategists with day-to-day execution admin

- Keep clean records of what was built, checked, and changed, and when



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

- Campaigns go live correctly, first time, with no costly build errors

- Client accounts stay clean, organised, and easy for anyone on the team to pick up

- Strategists trust your QC as a genuine safety net, not a rubber stamp

- High volume of builds handled without a drop in accuracy

- Problems are flagged before they become expensive



THE SKILLS WE NEED YOU TO BRING:

- 1-2+ years hands-on experience building campaigns in Meta Ads Manager

- Genuinely detail-obsessed; you double-check your own work as a habit, not an instruction

- Solid understanding of Meta ad account structure (campaign / ad set / ad), targeting, budgets, and pixel/conversion events

- Comfortable working from a brief and following a checklist precisely

- Strong organisational skills; nothing falls through the cracks on your desk

- Able to work at pace across multiple accounts without cutting corners



NICE-TO-HAVES:

- Experience with TikTok Ads Manager or other paid social platforms

- Experience in DTC / e-commerce accounts

- Familiarity with tools like Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar reporting tools

- Exposure to AI tools for creative production or QA



WHAT WE OFFER:

- Competitive salary (based on experience)

- Fully flexible, remote working

- Paid public holidays and leave

- Direct collaboration with experienced Media Buyers and Strategists

- Clear progression into Paid Social / Media Strategist roles

- Opportunity to work on global e-commerce brands



RED FLAGS (Don't Apply if...)

- You're comfortable letting small errors slide because "it's probably fine"

- You need someone else to catch your mistakes for you

- You find checklists and process restrictive rather than helpful

- You struggle to keep multiple accounts organised at once

- You wait to be told something's wrong instead of flagging it yourself



OUR CULTURE

We believe in doing things well at The Graygency; we are constantly looking for ways to innovate and improve the delivery of our product. Every day we turn up and deliver our best work as a team in order to deliver the best results for the brands that trust us with their marketing budgets.



If you are ready to work and have the skills required, please submit your application directly here:

title: Experienced Video Editor & Content Producer – Part-Time, Long-Term
description:
Hours: 4 hours per day / 20 hours per week

Salary: $400–$500 USD per month, depending on experience

Location: Remote – Philippines

Position: Long-term, following an initial paid trial period



We are a growing UK professional services business looking for an experienced Video Editor & Content Producer to join our marketing team on a long-term, part-time basis.



This is not a basic video editing role where you will be given timestamps and told exactly what to cut.



We are looking for someone with strong editorial judgement who can take professionally recorded raw footage, understand the subject and identify the best content within it.



You should be comfortable thinking: "That answer would make a great 45-second standalone video." rather than waiting for us to tell you where the good parts are.



What You'll Be Working On:



We are significantly increasing our use of video across our website, YouTube and social media.



You will work with footage including:



- Professionally recorded expert videos

- Interviews and conversations

- Educational and thought-leadership content

- Monthly webinars

- Website videos

- Longer-form YouTube content



Your job will be to turn this footage into high-quality content for multiple uses.



This will include:



- Editing polished videos for our website

- Producing longer-form YouTube videos

- Identifying highlights within longer recordings

- Creating YouTube Shorts and other short-form videos

- Creating content for LinkedIn, Instagram and potentially TikTok

- Turning webinars into useful evergreen videos

- Extracting strong standalone clips from webinars and longer recordings

- Adding professional captions, graphics, titles and other visual elements where appropriate

- Creating different formats and aspect ratios for different platforms

- Creating engaging thumbnails and video covers



We do not want every platform to simply receive a resized version of the same edit. You should understand that a website video, YouTube video, LinkedIn video and Instagram Reel can require different treatment.



The Most Important Part of the Role-



- You need to be a self-starter. We don't want to spend hours reviewing footage and giving you a list of timestamps.



We want to be able to give you the raw material, explain the purpose and audience, and trust you to identify what is worth producing.



As you become familiar with our business, we want you to increasingly make recommendations about how our existing footage can be repurposed and what video content we should create next.



Who We're Looking For:



You should have:



- Strong professional video editing experience

- Excellent spoken and written English comprehension

- Experience editing both long-form and short-form content

- Strong editorial judgement and storytelling ability

- Experience creating content for YouTube and social platforms

- Good understanding of pacing, hooks and viewer retention

- Experience with captions, graphics and basic motion graphics

- Good visual/design judgement

- Strong attention to detail

- Excellent organisation and file management

- The ability to work independently and meet deadlines



Experience creating YouTube thumbnails and social media graphics would be a significant advantage.



Experience working with professional services, educational, expert-led or B2B content would also be particularly useful.



Working With Our Marketing Team:



You will work closely with our full-time Marketing Executive, Angel.



Angel will lead our wider marketing and content programme, while we expect you to take ownership of the video production side.



If you also have experience with social media content strategy, analytics or developing content ideas, that's a bonus. Over time, we'd like you to contribute ideas based on what you're seeing in the footage and what performs well.



However, excellent video editing and the ability to work independently are the priority.



Hours and Working Arrangement:



This is initially a 20-hour-per-week role, approximately 4 hours per day Monday to Friday.



We are happy to provide some flexibility around working hours, although there should be reasonable overlap with the UK working day and good communication with our marketing team and leadership.



There will initially be a substantial amount of professionally recorded footage to work through, followed by an ongoing programme of new videos, webinars and social content.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team, not someone looking for occasional freelance projects.



Salary:



$400–$500 USD per month, depending on experience and portfolio.



The role will begin with an initial paid trial period of 2 weeks, with the intention of continuing long-term if it is a good fit for both sides.



How to Apply:



Please send us:



- A short introduction about yourself and your video editing experience.

- Links to 3 examples of your best work – ideally including both long-form and short-form content.

- Examples of any thumbnails or graphics you have designed.

- Details of the editing and design software you regularly use.

- A brief explanation of how you approach a long recording when the client has not provided timestamps and wants you to identify the best clips yourself.

- Your expected monthly salary for a 20-hour-per-week position.



Please don't send us dozens of portfolio links. We would rather see three pieces of work you are genuinely proud of.



We are particularly interested in hearing from experienced editors who enjoy taking ownership of their work and want a stable, long-term position with a growing business.

title: Controller
description:
Controller



Position Type: TBD

Work Arrangement: Remote

Industry: Medical Equipment / Distribution

Reports To: Executive Leadership



Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced Controller to lead and oversee the company’s accounting and financial operations. This role requires a hands-on finance leader who can manage the full accounting cycle while providing management with clear visibility into cash flow, profitability, margins, inventory, and overall financial performance.



The ideal candidate will have strong experience in distribution or wholesale, particularly with inventory accounting, COGS management, equipment sales, and margin analysis. Experience working with a U.S.-based company and understanding U.S. GAAP is required.



Because the company has recently undergone an acquisition, the Controller will also play an important role in post-acquisition financial integration, including improving reporting processes, supporting system integration, and developing reliable financial reporting for the new ownership structure.



Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Financial Operations

Manage the company’s full-cycle accounting operations, including:

General Ledger

Accounts Payable

Accounts Receivable

Payroll

Bank and account reconciliations

Month-end and year-end close

Maintain accurate and timely financial records in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

Prepare and review financial statements, including the Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Statement, Cash Flow Statement, and supporting schedules.

Establish and maintain strong internal controls and accounting procedures.

Coordinate with external CPAs, auditors, tax professionals, and other financial partners.

Ensure accounting deadlines, reporting requirements, and compliance obligations are consistently met.

Cash Flow & Financial Management

Own the company’s cash flow management and forecasting process.

Develop short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts.

Monitor incoming customer payments and outgoing vendor, payroll, tax, and operating obligations.

Identify potential cash flow issues and proactively communicate them to leadership.

Provide recommendations to improve working capital and cash availability.

Analyze financial performance and provide management with actionable recommendations.

Inventory, COGS & Distribution Accounting

Oversee accounting for inventory, including inventory costing, valuation, cycle counts, adjustments, and shrinkage.

Monitor and analyze Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and gross margins.

Review equipment sales margins and identify profitability trends.

Analyze inventory purchases, vendor costs, freight, and other costs affecting product margins.

Work with operations and sales teams to ensure inventory and project costs are accurately captured.

Develop reporting that provides visibility into profitability by product, customer, project, or business segment.

Post-Acquisition Integration

Support the financial integration of the company following the recent acquisition.

Assist with the integration of accounting processes, systems, financial records, and reporting requirements.

Help establish consistent accounting policies and procedures under the new ownership structure.

Support potential ERP or accounting-system migration and implementation.

Develop and maintain accurate reporting for ownership and executive leadership.

Prepare or support monthly management and board-level financial reporting packages.

Establish KPIs and dashboards that provide ownership with clear visibility into financial performance.

Ensure financial data from multiple entities or business units can be consolidated accurately when required.

Financial Analysis & Strategic Support

Provide leadership with financial analysis to support business decisions.

Analyze revenue, expenses, gross margins, operating costs, working capital, and profitability.

Develop budgets, forecasts, and financial models.

Identify cost-saving opportunities and areas for improving profitability.

Evaluate the financial impact of major purchases, vendor agreements, projects, and business initiatives.

Partner with leadership to establish financial targets and monitor performance against them.

Industry & Compliance Responsibilities

Apply accounting knowledge relevant to medical equipment and distribution businesses.

Understand the financial impact of OEM/vendor relationships, rebates, discounts, and partner agreements.

Understand the accounting differences between capital equipment and consumable products.

Maintain awareness of applicable sales-tax considerations related to medical equipment.

Support compliance requirements applicable to the company’s healthcare-adjacent business relationships.

Maintain appropriate documentation for financial transactions and vendor/customer relationships.

Qualifications

Required Experience

5–8+ years of accounting or finance experience.

2–3+ years of experience in a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager role.

Strong background in distribution, wholesale, or equipment-based businesses.

Demonstrated experience managing full-cycle accounting.

Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP.

Experience with inventory accounting, COGS, and gross-margin analysis.

Experience with cash flow forecasting and financial planning.

Experience preparing and analyzing financial statements.

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and financial modeling capabilities.

Experience with accounting/ERP systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage, or similar platforms.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Preferred Experience

Medical device, medical equipment, healthcare, or healthcare-adjacent industry experience.

Experience with post-acquisition integration.

Experience working under a private equity, holding company, or investor-owned structure.

Experience with multi-entity accounting and consolidation.

Experience implementing or migrating ERP/accounting systems.

Experience preparing investor, board, or PE-style reporting packages.

Familiarity with vendor rebates and OEM partner agreements.

Experience analyzing profitability for capital equipment sales.

Remote Work Requirements

Previous experience working remotely with a U.S.-based team.

Ability to maintain meaningful working-hour overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.

Strong communication skills when working with executives, vendors, customers, OEM partners, and internal teams.

Highly organized, self-directed, and capable of managing deadlines independently.

Comfortable working with cloud-based accounting, communication, and business systems.

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is more than a bookkeeper or financial reporting specialist. We are looking for a hands-on Controller who can understand the entire financial picture of the business and help leadership make better decisions.



This person should be able to clearly answer:



How much cash do we have available?

What cash is expected to come in and when?

What payments and obligations are coming due?

Which products, projects, and customers are most profitable?

Where are margins being lost?

How much capital is tied up in inventory?

What is driving changes in COGS and gross margin?

How is the business performing against budget and forecast?

What financial risks should leadership be aware of?

What actions can the company take to improve cash flow and profitability?

Key Success Measures



Success in this role will be measured by:



Accurate and timely monthly financial close.

Reliable financial statements and management reporting.

Improved cash flow visibility and forecasting accuracy.

Strong inventory and COGS controls.

Accurate gross-margin and profitability reporting.

Timely identification of financial risks and opportunities.

Successful integration of accounting processes following the acquisition.

Effective reporting to executive leadership and new ownership.

Improved financial controls, processes, and operational efficiency.



Send Resume to 
 only!

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
Trendstop is a fashion trend forecasting agency providing trend intelligence, analysis, and inspiration to fashion professionals and businesses.



We are looking for a highly visual, fashion focused Social Media Content Creator who can translate Trendstop’s forecasting expertise and extensive visual content into compelling, beautifully curated social media.



This role requires more than general social media experience. The successful candidate will have an exceptional eye for fashion imagery, strong aesthetic judgment, and advanced copy editing skills, with a clear understanding of how to communicate with different audiences across the professional fashion industry.



Key Responsibilities



Visual Content Creation and Curation

- Select strong, relevant, and visually engaging fashion, runway, street style, product, color, and trend imagery from Trendstop’s content.

- Demonstrate excellent image selection and aesthetic sequencing skills, creating visually cohesive stories rather than simply assembling individual images.

- Curate attractive, high impact Instagram carousels, Reels, and other short form social content that communicates fashion trends clearly and inspires audiences.

- Understand how image order, color, composition, scale, rhythm, and contrast work together to create an engaging visual narrative.

- Identify strong opening images and sequences that capture attention and encourage audiences to continue viewing.

- Edit and adapt visual assets appropriately for different social platforms and formats.

- Maintain a sophisticated, contemporary visual aesthetic consistent with Trendstop’s positioning as a fashion trend forecasting agency.



Fashion Copywriting and Copy Editing

- Write and edit concise, engaging social copy based on Trendstop’s fashion trend forecasting content.

- Apply advanced copy editing skills to transform detailed trend analysis into clear, compelling, and accessible social media content.

- Adapt language, tone, emphasis, and level of detail to appeal to specific professional fashion target audiences, including designers, buyers, product developers, merchandisers, marketers, and fashion business decision makers.

- Create strong headlines, captions, hooks, and calls to action while maintaining Trendstop’s expert and authoritative voice.

- Understand how to balance visual inspiration with useful professional fashion insight.

- Ensure all published copy is accurate, polished, and consistent with Trendstop’s editorial standards.



Social Media Content and Planning

- Create and manage a regular social media content calendar aligned with Trendstop’s editorial, marketing, and commercial priorities.

- Develop content for Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other relevant channels, adapting the creative approach to suit each platform and target audience.

- Identify opportunities within Trendstop’s forecasting content that can be transformed into engaging social stories, carousels, and Reels.

- Monitor fashion, cultural, and social media trends to identify relevant content opportunities and emerging formats.

- Work with the wider Trendstop team to support campaigns, reports, events, and key seasonal trend stories.

- Review content performance and use audience and engagement insights to continuously improve image selection, sequencing, messaging, and content formats.



Essential Skills and Experience



- Professional experience in social media content creation, fashion content, editorial content, or a closely related creative role.

- A demonstrably strong visual eye for fashion and contemporary aesthetics.

- Exceptional ability to select, edit, and sequence imagery into sophisticated and engaging visual stories.

- Experience producing visually compelling fashion carousels and Reels.

- Advanced copywriting and copy editing skills, particularly the ability to distill complex information into concise and engaging social content.

- Ability to tailor content to different professional fashion audiences rather than writing for a general consumer audience.

- Strong understanding of fashion terminology, trends, and the wider fashion industry.

- Excellent attention to detail across both imagery and written content.

- Strong understanding of Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and evolving social content formats.

- Competence with relevant image, video, and design editing tools.



Highly Desirable Experience

- Previous experience within fashion trend forecasting, fashion media, fashion publishing, or a fashion brand.

- A background in fashion, design, communications, journalism, or a related discipline.

- Understanding of the needs of fashion designers, buyers, product developers, merchandisers, and other industry professionals.

- Experience working with large image libraries and editorial content.

- Strong knowledge of runway collections, street style, color, materials, and emerging fashion trends.



What We Are Looking For



- The ideal candidate combines the instincts of a fashion image editor, social content creator, and skilled copy editor. They can look through a large selection of imagery and quickly recognize which images work together, how they should be sequenced, and what story they tell.

- They understand that successful Trendstop social content needs to be visually desirable while also delivering credible fashion intelligence. They know how to turn expert forecasting material into content that feels immediate, inspiring, and relevant to the specific fashion professionals Trendstop wants to reach.



How to Apply

title: Anti-Fraud Operations Specialist
description:
Role Overview



The Anti-Fraud Operations Specialist is responsible for protecting our users, platform, and brand from phishing, scams, fake domains, impersonation attempts, and other fraud-related threats. 



The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring alerts, investigating suspicious activity, documenting findings, submitting abuse and takedown requests, and following established Anti-Fraud SOPs and escalation procedures.



The role requires strong attention to detail, disciplined documentation, sound judgment, and the ability to work carefully with sensitive fraud and security-related cases.



Key Responsibilities

- Monitor and review phishing, scam, impersonation, and other fraud-related alerts and reports.

- Investigate suspicious websites, domains, URLs, links, wallet addresses, and reported fraud cases.

- Submit abuse reports, phishing reports, and takedown requests to relevant platforms, registrars, hosting providers, or other third parties.

- Maintain accurate case trackers, phishing watchlists, investigation records, evidence, and case outcomes.

- Follow established Anti-Fraud SOPs, investigation procedures, and escalation guidelines consistently.

- Act quickly on confirmed or suspected phishing and impersonation cases and escalate high-risk cases when required.

- Coordinate clearly with Support, Security, and other relevant teams to ensure cases are handled appropriately.

- Prepare clear investigation notes, case summaries, status updates, and reports on fraud cases handled.





Candidate Profile

- Highly detail-oriented and able to identify suspicious patterns, inconsistencies, and fraud indicators.

- Reliable and disciplined in maintaining trackers, documentation, evidence, and follow-up records.

- Able to follow SOPs and escalation procedures carefully without skipping required steps.

- Comfortable working with links, websites, forms, reports, spreadsheets, and repetitive investigation tasks.

- Able to investigate information thoroughly and make sound assessments based on available evidence.

- Organized and capable of managing multiple cases while maintaining accuracy and timely follow-ups.

- Able to communicate and coordinate clearly with different internal teams.

- Comfortable handling sensitive fraud and security-related information with discretion and appropriate urgency.



Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience in fraud operations, trust and safety, risk operations, security operations, abuse operations, brand protection, or a related field.

- Experience investigating phishing, scams, impersonation, fake domains, malicious URLs, or other forms of online abuse.

- Familiarity with domain registrations, WHOIS/RDAP information, hosting providers, registrars, social platforms, or common abuse-reporting processes.

- Experience submitting abuse reports or takedown requests to registrars, hosting providers, social media platforms, search engines, or other third parties.

- Familiarity with cryptocurrency or blockchain-related fraud investigations, including reviewing wallet addresses or transaction-related information, is an advantage.

- Experience working with case-management tools, spreadsheets, trackers, ticketing systems, or internal investigation platforms.

- Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts related to phishing, social engineering, malicious domains, and account impersonation is an advantage.



Success in This Role

Success in this role means that fraud-related cases are identified quickly, investigated carefully, documented accurately, escalated appropriately, and followed through to resolution.



The Anti-Fraud Operations Specialist should be someone the organization can rely on to consistently execute established processes, maintain accurate records, recognize suspicious activity, and respond promptly when users or the brand is at risk.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

title: Graphic Designer - Meta & TikTok Ad Statics
description:
THIS IS A SPECIALIST ROLE. IF YOU CALL YOURSELF A GENERALIST, SKIP IT.

 

We are not looking for someone who does a bit of design, a bit of video,

a bit of social media management. We want one person who builds graphics

- ad statics and marketing assets - to a brief, at volume, better than

anyone else we can find.

 

One craft. Done properly.

 

 

ABOUT US

 

Zero Penny runs paid advertising for about 20 clients across iGaming,

finance, supplements, streaming, energy and telehealth. We have been

doing this for over a decade. Every client needs static ads, in their

own language, to a locked brief, on a fixed date.

 

 

WHAT THE WORK ACTUALLY IS

 

A brief lands in Asana. It contains:

- a blueprint showing where every element sits

- a copy sheet with the exact words

- a brand block with the exact hex codes and the font we must use

- a list of things that must never appear on the image

 

You build the 4:5 master at 1080x1350. You send it. Once it is approved,

you re-stack it to 9:16 at 1080x1920 - rebuilding the layout for the

taller canvas, not cropping it.

 

Then you do that five more times, and the batch ships in 24 hours.

 

Alongside client ads you will also design case studies, result posts and

testimonials for our own marketing.

 

 

THE PARTS PEOPLE FIND HARD

 

1. The copy is usually in a language you do not speak - German, Italian,

   Turkish, Spanish, Arabic, Dutch. You set it exactly as written. You

   do not "fix" it, even when it looks wrong to you.

 

2. The restrictions are specific and real. No "free". No broadcaster or

   league names. No guarantees. No drawn CTA buttons. No URLs or QR

   codes. Each client has their own list.

 

3. When a brief contradicts itself, the right move is to comment and

   stop. Not guess. Not
 the client.

 

4. When we ask you to remove something, we need exactly that removed and

   nothing new added in its place. Revisions are part of every job here.

 

 

HOW WE MAKE THE IMAGES

 

We work at volume, and that is only possible because the photography in

our ads is AI-generated and then composited and polished by the designer.

Our team uses Higgsfield. If you use something else, that is fine.

 

What is never AI-generated: any text on the image, and logos. All type is

set by you in Figma over the base. AI cannot spell German, and a garbled

headline on a live client account is the most expensive mistake in this job.

 

 

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 

Not brand identity. Not video editing. Not creative strategy. Not landing

pages. Not social media management.

 

The layout, colours, typeface and words arrive locked. Your craft shows up

in execution - spacing, hierarchy, compositing, how the 9:16 reads on a

phone. If you need freedom over those decisions to enjoy your work, you

will be unhappy here and we would both rather find that out now.

 

 

WHAT YOU NEED

 

- A portfolio of ad statics and marketing assets built to spec. Not

  posters, not logo collections, not brand books.

- Figma, fluently. Components and auto-layout, not flattened files.

- Photoshop and Illustrator.

- Comfort with AI image generation. We will teach our workflow. We cannot

  teach the eye.

- A track record of hitting deadlines without being chased.

 

 

HOURS

 

Your working day must include at least 6 hours between 12:30pm and 9:30pm

Manila time. That is our team's working window.

 

 

HOW WE HIRE

 

1. We review your application and portfolio

2. A short screen-recorded walkthrough of one of your own build files

3. A PAID trial task - USD 30, paid in full before you start, yours

   whether or not we hire you. It is two rounds and includes the revision

   round, because that is how the real work runs.

4. A call

 

 

HOW TO APPLY - READ THIS PART CAREFULLY

 

Start your application with a link to ONE ad static you designed, shown

at BOTH 4:5 and 9:16.

 

If you cannot show the same concept in both sizes, this role is not a fit

and we will not reply.

 

Then tell us, in two sentences maximum:

- how many ad statics you personally designed in the last 12 months

- which AI image tool you use

 

Applications that do not start with the link will not be read.

About Us

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and practical AI Operations Specialist to support kdmHomes' homebuilding projects through the hands-on and strategic use of Artificial Intelligence tools — with a core focus on Claude by Anthropic.

This role is specifically designed to support kdmHomes' residential housebuilding operations. The successful candidate will use Claude daily to assist in the planning, coordination, documentation, compliance, and reporting needs of our housing development projects across Ireland and the UK.

The ideal candidate is someone who understands the life cycle of a residential housebuilding project — from concept and planning through to construction and handover — and who can apply Claude and AI tools practically and effectively at every stage of that process.

AI-Assisted Project Planning & Design Support

Construction Stage Coordination & Reporting

? Use Claude to prepare clear and accurate weekly and monthly construction progress reports for each active housing development.

? Use AI tools to track construction stage completions, flag delays, and prepare management summaries on project status across multiple sites.

? Use Claude to draft site instructions, construction-related correspondence, and stakeholder communications on behalf of the management team.

? Assist in preparing handover packs, snag lists, and project closeout documentation for completed housing units using AI tools.

? Use AI to coordinate and track outstanding actions, defect lists, and post-completion works across developments.

Procurement & Materials Support

? Use Claude to research and compare construction materials, product specifications, and supplier options relevant to 



kdmHomes' housebuilding requirements.

? Use AI tools to prepare supplier comparison reports, material schedules, and procurement summaries for management review.

? Use Claude to assist in drafting purchase orders, supplier briefs, and product specification requests for construction materials.

? Use AI to monitor market pricing trends for key construction materials and prepare concise cost intelligence reports for the procurement team.

? Assist in verifying supplier invoices and delivery dockets against purchase orders using AI-assisted document review.



Cost Control & Quantity Surveying Support

? Use Claude to assist the quantity surveying team in producing, formatting, and reviewing bills of quantities and material schedules for individual house types.

? Use AI tools to prepare cost reports, budget summaries, and expenditure analyses for each active housing development.

? Use Claude to cross-check and review subcontractor valuations, variations, and final accounts for accuracy and completeness.

? Assist in producing cost-to-complete forecasts and budget variance reports for management using AI tools.

Document Control & Knowledge Management

? Use Claude to maintain a structured and accurate document control system across all kdmHomes housing projects.

? Use AI tools to manage drawing registers, specification logs, and correspondence records for each development.

? Use Claude to draft, review, and enhance contracts, subcontractor agreements, and project-specific documentation.

? Develop and maintain a library of Claude prompts and AI workflows specifically tailored to kdmHomes' housebuilding operations.

? Use AI to produce clear summaries of long technical documents, contracts, and reports for management review.



Management Reporting & Communications

? Use Claude to prepare weekly and monthly management reports covering project progress, cost performance, procurement status, and compliance across all active developments.

? Use AI tools to produce board-level presentations, project briefings, and stakeholder updates in a clear and professional format.

? Use Claude to draft, proofread, and enhance all management communications, external correspondence, and client-facing documents.

AI Tool Development & Team Support:

• Guide and support team members in the effective and responsible use of Claude and other AI platforms.

Advantageous

title: Video Editor – YouTube Travel & Nightlife Content
description:
## Video Editor – YouTube Travel & Nightlife Content



I’m looking for a **long-term video editor** to help with YouTube travel, nightlife, interview, and vlog-style content.



### #1 REQUIREMENT — DaVinci Resolve



You **must be highly experienced and fluent in DaVinci Resolve**.



This is non-negotiable.



You should be comfortable working efficiently with:



* Edit Page

* Fairlight

* Color Page

* Fusion when needed

* Adjustment clips

* Keyframes

* Tracking and masking

* Face/object blurring

* Audio cleanup and leveling

* Multicam or multiple-camera footage

* Proxies / optimized media

* Project organization

* Export presets and YouTube delivery



I am **not** looking for someone who primarily edits in Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut, or another editor and is simply willing to learn Resolve.



I need someone who already uses DaVinci Resolve regularly and understands it well enough to work quickly without needing basic instruction.



### What I’m Looking For



The ideal editor understands that good editing is much more than removing dead space.



You should have a strong feel for:



* Storytelling

* Pacing

* Comedy and timing

* Keeping conversations interesting

* Knowing when to cut and when to let a moment breathe

* Music selection and placement

* B-roll

* Subtle zooms and motion

* Tasteful sound effects when appropriate

* Building an entertaining story from unscripted footage



The goal is to make the video entertaining because of the **story, personalities, conversations, pacing, and timing** — not because there is an effect every few seconds.



### Editing Style — Important



I am **not** looking for an editor whose primary experience is:



* Gaming videos or gameplay highlight reels

* Gaming clips or montage-style content

* Hyperactive short-form or TikTok-style editing

* Meme-heavy editing

* Constant animated captions

* Excessive zooms

* Flashy transitions

* Overused sound effects

* Random reaction inserts

* Cheesy effects such as “5 hours later,” meme cutaways, cartoon graphics, or similar gimmicks



Those styles may work well for other channels, but they are not the style I am looking for.



My content is primarily **real-world travel, nightlife, interviews, conversations, and vlog footage**.



I prefer editing that feels:



* Natural

* Clean

* Polished

* Mature

* Cinematic when appropriate

* Entertaining without feeling over-edited



A strong editor for this position should understand that sometimes the best editing decision is **not adding anything at all**.



### Current Channel & Future Content



You can review the current channel here:



**YouTube: No Second Chances**



Please watch several videos before applying so you understand the current pacing, style, personalities, and overall tone.



However, do **not** assume every future project will look exactly like the current channel.



We will also be producing other types of content, including:



* Travel videos

* Destination and location guides

* Interviews

* Lifestyle content

* Documentary-style segments

* Restaurant and activity videos

* Other real-world unscripted content



I am looking for an editor who can adapt to different types of videos while still maintaining strong storytelling and good judgment.



### Typical Content



Most projects involve:



* Travel vlogs

* Nightlife videos

* Street interviews

* Restaurant and location segments

* Conversations with guests

* Unscripted situations

* Longer footage that needs to be shaped into an entertaining story



Footage may come from:



* Mirrorless cameras

* Action cameras

* Phones

* 360 cameras

* Multiple cameras during the same shoot



You should be comfortable sorting through longer recordings and identifying the moments that are actually worth keeping.



### Audio



Audio quality is extremely important.



You should be comfortable using **Fairlight** to:



* Balance dialogue levels

* Reduce background noise when appropriate

* Compress dialogue

* EQ voices

* Control peaks

* Mix background music underneath conversations

* Keep volume consistent throughout the video

* Handle audio from different cameras and microphones



I do not want to constantly repair audio after receiving an edit.



### Color



You should be comfortable doing basic color correction and matching footage between different cameras.



I prefer:



* Natural skin tones

* Realistic colors

* Clean contrast

* Consistent exposure

* A polished but realistic image



I do **not** want:



* Heavy HDR looks

* Oversaturation

* Orange skin

* Extreme sharpening

* Aggressive LUTs

* Artificial-looking color grades



### Internet Connection — Very Important



Because we regularly work with **large amounts of high-resolution video footage**, a fast and reliable internet connection is extremely important.



Your computer hardware is your responsibility. I do not care what system you use as long as you can edit the footage efficiently and deliver reliable results.



Your internet connection must be capable of regularly downloading and uploading very large project files.



**Minimum preferred connection:**



* 100 Mbps download

* 100 Mbps upload

* Stable connection

* No restrictive monthly data cap



Faster is strongly preferred.



Applicants may be asked to provide a recent Speedtest result showing download speed, upload speed, and ping.



### Organization



Projects should have:



* Properly named timelines

* Organized bins

* Clean media organization

* Logical folder structure

* Consistent file naming

* No unnecessary duplicate media

* No missing assets when a project is returned



I want to be able to open your DaVinci Resolve project and immediately understand how it is organized.



### Workload



We will start with approximately **one long-form video per week**.



A typical finished video will usually be around **20–40 minutes long**.



If the working relationship goes well, additional projects and more frequent work may become available.



I would rather start slowly, establish a good workflow, and increase the workload once we know we work well together.



### Compensation



Compensation will generally be **per completed video rather than open-ended hourly billing**.



A normal 20–40 minute long-form video will typically pay approximately:



**$80–150 USD per completed video**



Final pricing depends on:



* Amount of raw footage

* Number of cameras

* Audio complexity

* Required masking or blurring

* Amount of B-roll

* Overall difficulty of the project



More complicated projects can be priced separately.



Before work begins, we will agree on the:



* Scope

* Price

* Expected finished length

* Delivery date



Additional work outside the agreed scope should be discussed before doing it.



### Communication & Reliability



I am looking for someone dependable who:



* Communicates clearly

* Can follow detailed notes

* Takes constructive feedback well

* Learns from revisions

* Does not repeatedly make the same mistakes

* Can gradually become more independent

* Meets agreed deadlines



The goal is not for me to supervise every editing decision.



Over time, I want you to understand the channel well enough that I can send footage and notes and receive a strong first edit.



### Portfolio



When applying, please send examples of your **best long-form work**.



I am especially interested in:



* Travel videos

* Vlogs

* Interviews

* Documentary-style content

* Lifestyle content

* Real-world unscripted footage



Please do **not** send only:



* Gaming montages

* Shorts

* TikTok edits

* Music videos

* Meme compilations

* Special-effects reels



If your portfolio does not demonstrate long-form storytelling and pacing, it will be difficult to evaluate whether you are a good fit.



### Paid Test Edit



Final candidates may be asked to complete a **paid test edit** using the same footage and instructions.



This allows me to compare:



* Storytelling

* Editing decisions

* Pacing

* Audio

* Color

* Organization

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow instructions



If the test goes well, we will begin with approximately one video per week and build from there.



I am looking for quality and good judgment, not simply who can add the most effects.



### Current Channel & Future Content



You can review the current channel here:







Please watch **at least 2–3 recent videos before applying** so you understand the current pacing, style, personalities, and overall tone.



When you apply, please tell me:



* Which video(s) you watched

* One thing you think the current editing does well

* One thing you would improve or approach differently



There is no single “correct” answer. I want to see that you actually watched the content and understand the type of editing we are trying to improve.



However, do **not** assume every future project will look exactly like the current channel.



We will also be producing other types of content, including:



* Travel videos

* Destination and location guides

* Interviews

* Lifestyle content

* Documentary-style segments

* Restaurant and activity videos

* Other real-world unscripted content



I am looking for an editor who can adapt to different types of videos while maintaining strong storytelling, natural pacing, and good judgment.

title: Editor
description:
We're an Australian marketing agency running
 and Google ads for trade businesses. We need an editor to cut the short-form video ads that bring those businesses their customers.



What you'd be editing:

- Short vertical ads, 30 to 60 seconds, for
 and Instagram

- Talking-head videos of business owners filmed on their phone, on a job site

- Raw job footage — climbers in trees, chippers, before-and-after of a yard

- Cutting one filmed script into several versions with different opening hooks



What matters in this work:

- The first 3 seconds. These ads live or die on the hook. You'll cut several versions of the same ad just to test different openings.

- Burned-in captions on everything. Most people watch with the sound off. Captions must be accurate and easy to read on a phone.

- Australian accents and trade slang. The people on camera are Australian tradesmen — "smoko", "ute", "gum tree", "chipper", "stump grinder". Auto-captions get these wrong constantly and you will need to fix them by hand. This is the part most editors get lazy about and the part we care about most.

- Speed and volume. We're not making films. We need a steady flow of simple, clean, fast-paced ads — several a week, every week.



You'll be given the raw footage, the script that was filmed, and a clear brief for each ad. You won't be guessing what we want.



- Confident in CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve — whichever you're fastest in

- Accurate captioning, including fixing auto-generated captions by hand

- Clean, simple text overlays and basic motion (no heavy effects needed)

- Good written English — you'll be reading scripts and briefs, and captioning speech

- Reliable internet, able to handle large video files

- Able to work with feedback and turn revisions around the same day



Nice to have: experience editing ads (not just YouTube content), sound design basics, static/thumbnail design.



Please send:

1. Two or three examples of short-form vertical video you've edited. Ads or talking-head content preferred. Links only, no attachments.

2. One sentence on which editing software you're fastest in.

3. Your available hours per week and your rate.



Start your message with the word CHIPPER. Applications that don't start with that word won't be read.



If your samples look right, we'll send you one paid test edit — real footage, real script — and you'll be paid for it whether or not we hire you.

title: Senior Video Editor for AI Generated YouTube Content
description:
We're a small YouTube content studio and we need a senior video editor who can take our AI generated videos and turn them into something people actually want to watch. This is not an entry level position, we need someone with real editing experience and a strong portfolio, please don't apply if you're just starting out.



Here's how it works. The videos come to you already with voice over and basic transitions in place. From there we need you to clean them up and make them genuinely good. That means cutting out scenes that drag on too long or just don't make sense, since AI footage does weird stuff sometimes. It means adding animations, B roll, or whatever else is missing, and we'll always send you a reference video so you know exactly what we're going for. You'll need to resync the voiceover with ElevenLabs after making your cuts, follow the reference style we give you for each project, and export the file at roughly the same size and quality as the one we send you.



You'll also handle thumbnails. We generate the base image with Higgsfield and expect you to refine it in Photoshop or whatever tool you prefer. We honestly don't care what software you use, we care about the result.



Creativity is what matters most to us, but it has to come from experience. We don't want someone who just follows the brief word for word. We want bold, high impact editing choices, thumbnails and cuts that make people stop scrolling, the kind of instincts you only get from having done this for years. If you have a strong portfolio and some genuinely fun ideas, that's who we're looking for.



Monthly bonus up to PHP 5,000: PHP 2,500 for on-time delivery of all scheduled videos plus PHP 2,500 for quality, videos approved with max one revision round. Extra milestone bonuses as the channel grows.





Please include your years of experience and examples of your past work with your application.
