title: Client Retention Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a friendly, organized, and motivated Client Retention Specialist to join our law firm. This role is focused on building strong relationships with existing clients and helping them feel confident and supported throughout their experience with our firm.



The ideal candidate is comfortable speaking with people, understands the importance of follow-up, and knows how to listen to client concerns and help find solutions. You’ll work closely with attorneys, paralegals, and other team members to provide a positive client experience and help clients move forward with our services.





What You'll Do



- Communicate with existing clients by phone,
, and other channels.

- Build trust and maintain strong relationships with clients.

- Answer questions and address client concerns in a professional and compassionate manner.

- Maintain accurate and detailed notes of client communications and follow-ups.

- Keep client information and records updated in the firm’s database.

- Coordinate with attorneys, paralegals, and other staff regarding client needs.

- Help ensure clients feel heard, valued, and supported.

- Track follow-ups and retention activity and provide updates to management.

- Maintain strict confidentiality when handling client information.

- Assist with other client-service and administrative tasks as needed.



Qualifications



- Previous experience in customer service, client relations, sales, intake, or a similar role.

- Law firm or legal industry experience is a plus.

- Excellent communication and active listening skills.

- Comfortable speaking with clients about sensitive or personal matters.

- Friendly, professional, and confident when communicating by phone and
.

- Strong follow-up and organizational skills.

- Ability to handle difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.

- Good problem-solving skills and ability to take initiative.

- Must be able to maintain client confidentiality at all times.





How to Apply

If you enjoy helping people, building strong client relationships, and making sure clients have a positive experience with a law firm, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume along with a one-minute video introduction briefly highlighting your experience in client retention or customer support and sharing why you believe you’d be a great fit for this role.

title: Remote UI/UX & Visual Designer – Mobile Apps and Websites
description:
Job Overview 



We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented UI/UX and Visual Designer to join our team on a full-time remote basis. You will be responsible for designing user-friendly and visually appealing interfaces for mobile applications and websites. You will also create App Store and Google Play promotional screenshots, illustrations, marketing graphics, and other visual assets. 



Responsibilities



1. Design high-quality user interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

2. Design responsive interfaces for websites and web-based products.

3. Create wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and production-ready UI designs.

4. Design promotional screenshots and preview images for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

5. Present an app’s main features and selling points through clear and visually attractive app store creatives. 

6. Adapt app store screenshots for different devices, screen sizes, languages, and platform requirements. 

7. Create app icons, illustrations, banners, backgrounds, onboarding graphics, landing page visuals, and other marketing materials. 

8. Build and maintain reusable components, design systems, and visual guidelines. 

9. Use AI image generation tools to create concepts, illustrations, backgrounds, reference images, and promotional materials. 

10. Collaborate remotely with product managers, developers, and other team members. 

11. Prepare organized Figma files and provide clear design specifications for developers. 

12. Review implemented designs and provide feedback to ensure the final product matches the original design. 

13. Maintain visual consistency across different products, platforms, and screen sizes. 

14. Research current UI/UX and visual design trends and propose new creative ideas. 

15. Participate in online meetings and provide regular progress updates.



Requirements 

1. Proven experience designing mobile applications and websites. 

2. Strong experience designing App Store and Google Play screenshots, preview images, and promotional creatives. 

3. Ability to communicate an app’s key features and benefits through effective visual storytelling. 

4. Proficiency in Figma, including Auto Layout, components, variants, design systems, and interactive prototypes. 

5. Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator. 

6. Experience with AI image generation tools such as Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux, DALL·E, or similar tools. 

7. Good illustration skills and the ability to create, modify, and refine original visual assets. 

8. Strong understanding of layout, typography, color, composition, visual hierarchy, and responsive design. 

9. Familiarity with iOS and Android design guidelines. 

10. Familiarity with App Store and Google Play screenshot specifications. 

11. Ability to balance creativity, usability, marketing goals, and product requirements. 

12. Strong attention to detail and good file-management habits. 

13. Ability to work independently and manage tasks effectively in a remote working environment. 

14. Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with an international remote team. 

15. Reliable internet connection and availability during agreed working hours. 

16. A portfolio demonstrating mobile app UI, website UI, app store screenshots, illustrations, and visual design work is required.





Employment Type

Full-time Fully 

remote 

Long-term position

- Support and coordinate audit requirements and documentation.

- Identify process improvements to enhance finance efficiency and accuracy.

- Proven experience working with Australian companies or within an Australian accounting/finance environment. 

- Strong practical experience using Xero, including reconciliations, AP/AR, reporting, and general ledger management. 

- Experience in payroll processing, including monthly and fortnightly payment cycles. 

- Solid understanding of core accounting processes, including reconciliations, cash flow, payables, and receivables. 

- Experience supporting audits and preparing finance-related documentation. 

- Good understanding of Australian business and finance practices. 

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. 

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. 

- Ability to work remotely, manage deadlines, and maintain confidentiality. 



Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience in a professional services, financial advisory, accounting, or similar Australian business environment. 

- Exposure to Australian tax or compliance-related processes. 

- Accounting qualification, bookkeeping certification, or equivalent relevant experience. 

- Ability to provide financial insights beyond transactional processing. 



What We Are Looking For: 

- Reliable, proactive, and organised. 

- Comfortable working with an Australian team and Australian business standards. 

- Able to take ownership of finance tasks with minimal supervision. 

- Process-driven, accurate, and committed to meeting deadlines.

title: Full-Time WFH Client Success Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Customer Experience Agent - US Night Shift
description:
About Rest:



At Rest, we're redefining what comfort means through continuous innovation in form, material, and technology. We believe quality sleep is essential for overall well-being, and we're here to help people get the restful nights they deserve. Our mission is simple: Ensure Everyone Gets a Good Rest. Joining our team means becoming part of a company that pushes boundaries and leads with purpose. You'll be part of a collaborative and dynamic environment that fosters creativity and challenges the status quo. If you're looking for a place where your ideas will have a direct impact on both customer experience and business growth, you've found it.



Why You'll Love It Here:



At Rest, innovation isn't just a buzzword — it's at the core of everything we do. Our fully remote team works collaboratively, embracing innovation and providing the support and tools to help you succeed. If you're ready to make your mark in the sleep industry, we want you to be part of our journey.



About the Role:



We're looking for enthusiastic, customer-obsessed Customer Experience Agents to join our US team on the night shift. You'll be the friendly and knowledgeable voice behind Rest — supporting customers through every step of their journey, from product discovery to post-purchase care, across
, live chat, and phone.



This is a hands-on role on a small, high-ownership team. You won't be "just another agent" in a large call center: our CX team works in focused pods, sits close to operations and product, and our agents' feedback directly shapes our policies, macros, and playbooks.



It's also a role where AI is part of the job. A large share of our customer conversations are now assisted by AI, and our agents are the ones who supervise it — reviewing and improving AI-drafted replies, catching where automation gets it wrong, and flagging the gaps worth automating next. You don't need a technical background, but curiosity about AI tools will take you far here.



Schedule:



- 6 days per week, night shift

- 5 shifts × 7 hours on shift, each including a 30-minute unpaid break — 6.5 paid hours per shift

- 1 shift × 5 paid hours

- 37.5 paid hours per week total

- Shift pattern and rest day are set with your manager; some flexibility is expected around peak periods, launches, and holiday season





What You'll Be Doing:



- Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional tone in every customer interaction

- Handle a high volume of
, live chat, and phone contacts — product and sizing questions, order changes and cancellations, shipping and delivery updates, returns, exchanges, and warranty claims

- Share overnight coverage with the rest of the night-shift team — keep response times and queue health steady, pick up where teammates leave off, and hand over cleanly at shift change

- Handle complaints with care, de-escalate calmly, and propose the right solution efficiently within policy

- Become a genuine product expert on our full bedding range so you can answer any question with confidence

- Work alongside our AI support tools — review, edit, and approve AI-generated responses; correct and improve saved replies and knowledge-base content; escalate cases where automation is giving customers the wrong answer

- Keep customer records, tags, and case notes accurate and complete in Zowie (our helpdesk/CRM), and log returns and claims correctly in our internal trackers

- Collaborate with operations, fulfillment, returns, and product teams to resolve escalations

- Work seamlessly with a global team across several time zones, using async updates and clear written handovers

- Follow established SOPs, and escalate to the CX Lead or Manager when a case calls for it

- Contribute to continuous improvement of our processes, macros, FAQs, and CX tooling

- Other job duties related to the role as required





Who You Are:



- Available for the night shift, 6 days a week, on the schedule above — this is a firm requirement, not a preference

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; you can simplify detailed or technical information without sounding scripted

- Previous experience in customer service, phone support, or sales is ideal

- Comfortable on the phone: patient, warm, and able to hold your ground professionally in a difficult call

- Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and the judgment to prioritize when the queue is full

- Calm under pressure and adaptable in a fast-changing environment

- A proactive self-starter who brings solutions, not just problems, and a good teammate who communicates openly with the others on shift

- Tech-savvy and quick to pick up remote tools (helpdesk/CRM, chat, phone, ecommerce admin)

- Reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet workspace, and a personal workstation with a headset



Bonus — AI knowledge is a plus:



- Hands-on experience with AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in a work setting

- Experience working with an AI-assisted helpdesk or chatbot

- Comfort writing clear prompts and instructions, and a good eye for when an AI answer is confidently wrong

- Interest in helping design what gets automated next, rather than just working around it

- Passion for sleep, wellness, and helping people live better





What We Offer:



- A fast-paced, collaborative environment that fosters innovation

- The opportunity to have a direct impact on how we serve customers and how our CX function grows

- Work-from-anywhere flexibility — our fully remote workforce empowers you to create a workspace that suits your lifestyle

- A front-row seat to how AI is reshaping customer experience, and real input into how we use it

- Continuous learning and career development opportunities

- A team that values diversity, inclusion, and different perspectives

- A supportive environment that encourages personal growth and well-being





Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI):



At Rest, we believe diversity drives innovation and creates better products and experiences. Our mission to ensure everyone gets a good rest extends beyond our products — it shapes our culture. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued, supported, and empowered. We actively celebrate diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, and we encourage applications from people of all communities.

We don't just accept diversity — we celebrate it. We strive to build a company where everyone feels a sense of belonging and has the opportunity to thrive.

description:

s, proposals, follow-ups, research, organisation and general tasks that don't require me personally.

Managing and organising my inbox

Preparing, amending and sending proposals

Managing DocuSign documents

Following up with clients, suppliers and other contacts

Researching people, companies, products and opportunities

Organising meetings and my calendar

Coordinating contractors, tradespeople and appointments

Handling personal and household admin

Organising documents and information

Creating and maintaining SOPs

Turning voice notes and messy ideas into structured plans

Managing tasks and projects in our systems

Preparing information before meetings

Following up on outstanding tasks

Looking for ways to improve and automate repetitive processes

Using AI to complete work faster and more effectively

AI experience is important



I use Viktor, Claude and ChatGPT extensively, so you need to be genuinely comfortable working with AI.



I'm not looking for someone who simply uses ChatGPT to write
s.



I want someone who thinks:



"There must be a better way to do this."



You should be comfortable using AI to:



Research

Analyse information

Create SOPs

Structure projects

Process large amounts of information

Draft and improve communications

Turn unstructured information into actionable tasks

Build repeatable workflows

Find ways to automate processes



Experience with Viktor is a major advantage and may be a requirement depending on your level of experience.



The person I'm looking for



You will probably be a great fit if you are:



Extremely organised

Proactive

Intelligent and naturally curious

Excellent at written and spoken English

Comfortable working independently

A fast learner

Very good at using technology

Naturally good at problem solving

Detail-oriented without getting stuck in the details

Comfortable managing multiple priorities

Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions



The most important quality is initiative.

I don't want ten questions back.

Done



Proposal amended and sent

Two people chased

Plumber booked

SOP created



Need James



One decision that genuinely requires me



That's the level of ownership I'm looking for.



Hours & compensation



20 hours per week



£500 per month



Remote position.

Examples of situations where you've proactively solved a problem without being told exactly what to do

title: Part-Time LinkedIn B2B Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Remote | Part-Time | Padel Travel & Corporate Experiences



We are an established padel travel business looking to develop a new corporate division focused on company breaks, incentives, team building and corporate padel experiences.



We are looking for an experienced LinkedIn B2B Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist who can help us build and execute a strategy to reach companies and generate qualified corporate enquiries through LinkedIn.



This is not simply a social media posting role.



We need someone who understands how to use LinkedIn as a B2B sales and lead-generation channel – identifying the right companies and decision-makers, creating compelling outreach campaigns, developing messaging sequences, testing different approaches and ultimately generating measurable business opportunities.



The Opportunity



Padel is one of the world's fastest-growing sports and provides an excellent format for corporate events, incentives and team-building experiences.



We want to target companies and decision-makers who may be interested in:



Corporate padel trips and breaks

Overseas company incentives

Team-building experiences

Corporate retreats

Client entertainment

Sales incentives and rewards

Company padel events and experiences



Your job will be to help us identify these potential customers and develop a structured LinkedIn strategy to turn them into qualified leads and sales opportunities.



What You'll Be Responsible For



You will take ownership of our LinkedIn B2B outreach strategy, including:



Strategy & Targeting



Develop a clear LinkedIn lead-generation strategy for our corporate offering

Identify the types of companies most likely to purchase corporate padel experiences

Define our ideal customer profiles

Identify the appropriate decision-makers and job titles within target organisations

Build targeted prospect lists

Recommend how we should position our corporate padel proposition



LinkedIn Outreach



Create and manage targeted LinkedIn prospecting campaigns

Develop connection request messaging

Write initial outreach messages

Create follow-up messaging sequences

Personalise campaigns for different industries and decision-maker profiles

Test different messages, propositions and calls to action

Develop strategies for turning connections into conversations and qualified leads



Content & Messaging

This may include:



LinkedIn outreach messages

Follow-up sequences

Sales messages

LinkedIn posts

Corporate proposition messaging

 follow-ups where appropriate

Calls to action designed to generate meetings and enquiries



We want someone who understands the difference between simply sending messages and creating commercially effective B2B outreach.



Measurement & ROI

You should understand how to track the performance of LinkedIn activity through the complete funnel, including:



Prospects ? Connections ? Conversations ? Qualified Leads ? Meetings ? Proposals ? Sales



We want to understand what is working, what isn't and what return we are generating from our investment.



You should be comfortable reporting on metrics such as:



Connection acceptance rates

Qualified leads generated

Meetings booked

Cost per lead

Conversion rates

Sales generated

Campaign ROI

Who We're Looking For

LinkedIn Sales Navigator

Developing multi-stage messaging sequences

Lead nurturing

A/B testing messaging and propositions

CRM or lead-management systems

Campaign analytics and reporting

Measuring lead-generation ROI

Experience within travel, corporate events, incentives, hospitality, sport or team building would also be an advantage.

We want someone who is:



Commercially minded

Data-driven

An excellent written communicator

Comfortable testing different approaches

Able to work independently

Focused on generating measurable results rather than vanity metrics

title: Social Media Manager (Organic) - AI Content Creator for Scandinavian Footwear Bran
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC footwear brand selling footwear to Sweden, Norway and the UK. Our customers are 50+ - real people with real foot problems, not a fashion crowd. 



All of our content is created with AI. Not because it's cheap, but because when it's done properly it's better and faster than a photoshoot. "Done properly" is the entire job.



The role



You own our organic social presence end to end: concepts, content creation, posting, stories — and the conversation that happens underneath it. You're not executing someone else's brief. You come up with the ideas, build the calendar, produce every asset, and you're the voice that talks to our audience every day.



What you'll do



Content



Develop organic content concepts and angles that actually stop the scroll for a 50–70 year old audience

Create all images and videos using AI tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield / Seedance, and whatever else you're strong in)

Plan and publish daily posts and stories across our channels

Maintain a consistent content calendar so we're never scrambling

Track what performs, iterate, and bring us new ideas every week



Community



Reply to comments and DMs on our organic posts, twice daily

Own the comment sections on our paid ads — this is high volume and it directly affects sales. A hesitant 65-year-old asking about sizing under an ad is a customer we win or lose depending on whether you answer

Hide or delete spam, scam links and competitor hijacking

Turn positive comments into conversations, and handle negative ones calmly and publicly without getting defensive

Escalate order-specific issues (tracking, returns, exchanges, complaints) to our customer support team instead of answering them yourself

Flag recurring questions and objections to us — they're free market research and they feed our next content and ads



Language — read this before you skip it



Most of our comments and DMs come in Swedish and Norwegian. You are not expected to speak these languages. We run a translation workflow with AI tools and provide approved reply templates, exactly as our support team does. What we need from you is the discipline to use that workflow properly every single time and to keep the brand voice consistent — warm, plain-spoken, never salesy, never talking down to older people.



What we care about most — read this part twice



Two things matter more than everything else combined:



Hyper-realism. Our content must look like it was shot on a real camera by a real person. Documentary and candid, realistic mixed lighting, natural imperfection. No AI glow, no rim light, no golden-hour haze, no plastic skin, no bokeh sparkle. If it looks "AI-generated," it's a failed asset.

100% product accuracy. Our shoe must be our shoe in every single frame. Correct sole, correct stitching, correct lacing, correct colorway, correct logo placement. Not "close enough." One wrong detail and the asset is unusable, because our customers notice and our brand loses credibility.



We do not want AI slop. We'd rather publish two perfect assets a week than twenty mediocre ones. If your instinct is to accept the first generation and move on, this role isn't for you.



You must have



Several years of hands-on social media management experience, ideally for an e-commerce or DTC brand

Deep, current, practical experience with AI image and video generation — specifically Google Flow / Veo, Higgsfield, Seedance, and similar

Proven ability to hold product consistency across generations using reference images, multi-angle references and start frames

Strong prompt-writing skills and the patience to regenerate 30 times to get one usable shot

Real community management experience, including handling negative comments on paid ads

A genuine eye for what looks real vs. what looks fake

Native or near-native written English

Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video work

The ability to work independently and hit your posting and reply schedule without being chased



Nice to have



Experience marketing to an older demographic

Basic video editing (cuts, captions, pacing)

Experience with footwear, health, wellness or comfort products

Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, NapoleonCat, Agorapulse or similar moderation tools

Familiarity with ElevenLabs or similar voice tools



Hours, pay and setup



2–4 hours per day, Monday–Friday, including two daily passes through comments and DMs. The better and faster you work, the fewer hours you need — we pay for output, not for hours logged.

You set your own fixed working hours, but you commit to them and tell us in advance if they change.

Long-term position with room to grow as the brand expands into new markets.

You get access through Meta Business Suite with your own account and assigned permissions — we never share passwords, and you never need to handle ours.

We provide the AI tools you'll need, a full asset library of product references, and reply templates.

Day-to-day communication over WhatsApp.

First week is a paid trial at full rate, so we both find out quickly if it's a fit.



How to apply



Use the subject line: REALISM — [Your Name]



Applications without this subject line are deleted unread.



In your application, include:



Your portfolio. Links to social accounts you've managed and AI content you've personally created. Show us your best hyper-realistic work. This is the single most important part of your application — a strong portfolio beats a strong CV every time.

Which AI tools you use and what you use each one for.

A short answer to this: How do you keep a physical product looking 100% identical across dozens of AI-generated images and video clips? Give us your actual workflow, not a general answer.

A comment under one of our ads says: "Looks like cheap Chinese junk, my friend ordered and never got them." Write your public reply, in English, exactly as you'd post it.

Three organic content ideas for a barefoot shoe brand selling to 60-year-old Scandinavians. Rough ideas are fine — we want to see how you think.





We reply to every serious application. Generic copy-paste applications get ignored.

title: Creative Iteration Specialist — Meta Video Ads (Full-time, Long-term)
description:
The role

We run direct-response e-commerce brands on Meta in Spanish-speaking markets. We produce a lot of video creative, and our winning ads die faster than they should, partly because we don't track iteration performance closely enough.



That's your job: keep winning ads alive longer, and know exactly which iterations work.



This is not a new-concept scriptwriting role. Our senior strategist owns new angles. You own iterations and repurposing of already-proven creatives.

- Monitor active winning ads weekly for fatigue signals (rising frequency, rising CPM, declining ROAS) and flag ones about to drop

- Write hook variations before they decline, varying the first 3 seconds in genuinely different ways: visual, audio/voiceover, and structural (not just a new opening line)

- Repurpose proven creatives across products where the angle transfers

- Track every iteration's result and report which types actually extended a winner's life

- Brief our video editors clearly



Requirements

- 1+ years with direct-response video ads on Meta

- Comfortable reading Ads Manager data (frequency, CPM, ROAS, CPA)

- Strong written English, highly organized, responsive on Slack

- You know the difference between a real hook variation and a cosmetic edit





Details

- Full-time, 40 hrs/week 

- Salary: 5$ 

- Long-term



How to apply — read carefully

- Start your subject line with the word PURPLE-TOE (applications without it are deleted unread)

One of our ads has run 3 weeks, frequency is at 1.8, ROAS is dropping. Give me 3 hook variations you'd make — and say why each is genuinely different, not cosmetic.

title: Crypto BD Team Lead | DeFi Partnerships & Qualified Appointment Setting  Crypto BD Lead
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

D. $250 partnership bonus when a partnership you originated or materially managed goes live AND at least $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain). An announcement or deployment with no qualifying mints does not pay

E. Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

F. No cap on appointment bonuses. One bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

G. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

H. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

- Follow company policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements.

- Identify opportunities to improve AP processes, accuracy, and efficiency.

**Qualifications:**

- Minimum 5+ years of accounts payable or related accounting experience.

- High school diploma or equivalent required.

- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

- Strong proficiency in accounting/ERP systems.

- Demonstrated ability to produce accurate, audit-ready AP records.

- Working knowledge of accounts payable internal controls and three-way matching.

- Ability to work effectively with Viewpoint Vista or similar construction-based ERP platforms.

title: Amazon Data Systems Lead
description:
AMAZON DATA SYSTEMS LEAD

Remote 

Project basis to start, ongoing retainer after

Rate: $8-15 USD based on experience



ABOUT LEAVEN

Leaven is a small, high-trust Amazon agency, core team in the Philippines, founder in Europe, clients mostly in the US. We manage five clients whose reporting still runs on manual downloads and ad-hoc AI prompts, four different ways, with no shared numbers. We need one person to build and maintain a centralized per-client data system (ads, sales, inventory, search query performance) so reporting compounds instead of restarting every month.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

# System Standard & Architecture

- Define and document one build standard for the per-client data system, with real authority to reject tools or approaches that don't fit it

- Design the architecture connecting Seller Central, Amazon Ads, and Brand Analytics data into a single per-client source of truth

- Own the technical roadmap for the dashboard build across all five clients

# Amazon Data Access & Integration

- Remediate Leaven's Selling Partner API developer access rejection (network and device security controls) as the first deliverable

- Establish direct, non-manual data feeds for ads, sales, inventory, and search query performance per client

- Navigate Selling Partner API, Advertising API, and Brand Analytics access and scope decisions

# Dashboard Build & Maintenance

- Build and ship the per-client performance dashboard, starting with one client and extending to all five

- Keep the system running and consistent as new clients are added, this is not a build-and-leave engagement

- Tier the existing alert pipeline (listing monitor to Zapier to ClickUp) so urgent and trivial alerts are distinguishable

# Internal Systems & Founder Handoff

- Revise the existing internal Claude Project and skill-file build, currently scoped directionally by a non-engineer founder, into an engineer-maintained system

- Take technical decisions off the founder's plate instead of routing them back for approval



WHO WE NEED

-Catches their own errors before shipping. Fast and confident is not enough if it's wrong

-Takes ownership of decisions instead of routing them back for approval

-Says "I don't know, I'd need to check" without discomfort, and is honest about what they've built versus read about

-Pushes back on scope instead of agreeing to everything offered

-Has hands-on Selling Partner API and/or Advertising API integration work they've actually shipped, not just read the docs

-Has built and maintained systems other people depended on daily, and uses LLM tools as working tools, not a subject of enthusiasm

-Bonus: prior Amazon developer application experience, agency or multi-client background, experience remediating access rejections tied to security controls.



Not a fit if: 

-you need detailed direction to move, you're more excited about AI as a topic than as a tool, or you've only shipped solo greenfield work with no ongoing maintenance responsibility.



HOW WE WORK

-async-first (ClickUp, Slack, Drive), minimal meetings, zero micromanagement, high standards delivered kindly. -Flexible hours, some overlap expected with the founder (window to be confirmed). 

-Project basis to start, converting to an ongoing retainer. Rate and hours open, to be discussed.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send: 

1. resume; 

2. short intro on a real system you built that others depended on daily, with a measurable outcome; years of experience with Amazon data systems (Selling Partner API, Advertising API, or comparable); availability and expected rate; 

3. a two-minute video answering: 

A. Who are you, and your current work situation?  

B. Why this role at Leaven?   

C What separates maintaining a system from just building one?   



Speak naturally, no script. No video, no consideration. Applications that read as ticket-execution, without a maintenance plan, won't be considered.



Interview Process: resume/video review, 30-min intro call, practical assessment, follow-up call on your reasoning.

# Senior HR Assistant | Recruitment & HR Administration | 3+ Years Experience



**Full-Time | Remote | US Business Hours | Long-Term Opportunity**



We are looking for an **experienced Senior HR Assistant** to provide direct support to our HR Manager across recruitment, candidate screening, HR administration, documentation, and day-to-day HR operations.



**THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION.**



We are specifically looking for someone with **3+ years of professional HR or recruitment experience** who can work independently, handle confidential information, maintain accurate records, and support an active hiring process.



The right candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of assigned responsibilities rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### Recruitment & Candidate Screening



* Review and evaluate resumes against specific job requirements

* Pre-screen candidates and identify qualified applicants

* Conduct initial candidate screening interviews when required

* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring teams

* Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process

* Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment trackers

* Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes

* Update HR trackers, spreadsheets, and internal databases

* Prepare reports and documentation as requested



### General Administrative Support



* Complete administrative tasks assigned by the HR Manager or management

* Maintain accurate spreadsheets and databases

* Organize files and documentation

* Follow HR procedures, SOPs, and internal processes

* Conduct research and gather information when requested

* Follow up on outstanding tasks and documentation

* Support other HR and administrative projects as needed

* **3+ years of professional HR, recruitment, or HR administration experience**

* Proven experience with **candidate screening and recruitment**

* Ability to work during **US business hours**

* Demonstrated reliability and consistent attendance



**General Virtual Assistant experience alone does NOT qualify as HR experience.**



## STRONGLY PREFERRED



We will prioritize candidates with experience in:



* High-volume recruitment

* Candidate sourcing

* Resume screening

* Phone/video pre-screening

* Interview scheduling

* Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)

* Employee onboarding

* Recruitment reporting

* Supporting US-based hiring managers

**Analytical** — You can evaluate candidates against requirements and recognize strong versus weak applicants.



**Detail-oriented** — You understand that incorrect HR documentation can create serious problems.



**Independent** — You can manage your workload without constant supervision.



**Proactive** — You identify what needs to be done and take action.

**Confidential** — You understand how to handle sensitive employee and candidate information appropriately.



**Reliable** — You consistently meet your schedule, deadlines, and responsibilities.



## APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



**PLEASE FOLLOW THESE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY.**



To be considered, your application MUST include the following:



### 1. Total HR/Recruitment Experience



State your total number of years of professional HR/recruitment experience.



**Example: 5 years**



### 2. Most Recent HR Role

* Company/industry

* Job title

* Dates employed

* Main responsibilities

## APPLICATION SCREENING PHRASE

mber who can take ownership of HR and recruitment responsibilities and provide reliable support to our HR Manager.**

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

description:
Job Title: QLD Property Management Virtual Assistant



Work Schedule: Monday to Friday (AEST / Brisbane Business Hours) + On-Call Availability



Salary: $1,500 – $1,700 AUD / month (~$1,050 – $1,200 USD / month based on QLD PM experience) + After-Hours Call-Out Rates



Employment Type: Full-Time, Long-Term Remote



About Start Small Property

We are a modern, tech-forward, cloud-based property management agency operating across Queensland. We run on automated, systemized workflows using PropertyMe, Inspection Express (360 AI), Hubstaff, and Whale playbooks.



We do not operate like traditional, paper-heavy agencies. We value precision, high energy, attention to detail, and zero-error execution. We are seeking a rockstar Virtual Assistant who knows Queensland Property Management inside and out to join our fast-paced remote team.



Non-Negotiable Requirements

Do NOT apply if you do not meet all of the following criteria:



1. 2+ Years Direct QLD Real Estate Experience: Deep familiarity with Queensland property management workflows, tenant onboarding, lease agreements, and RTA compliance.



2. Platform Fluency: High operational proficiency in PropertyMe (required), Reapit / 2Apply (preferred), and Inspection Express / 360 AI (preferred).



3. Hardware & Power/Internet Backups (Mandatory):

   - Own personal Windows computer/laptop (i5/16GB RAM minimum)

   - Dual monitor 24" minimum

   - iPad / Tablet for routine review processing and digital documentation

   - Backup Power Source / Power Bank (must be capable of powering your internet/laptop during local outages)

   - Backup Secondary Internet Connection (mobile hotspot or second ISP)



4. On-Call Availability: Willingness to monitor and respond to urgent after-hours call-outs on evenings/weekends (paid at a premium hourly rate).



Key Responsibilities

- Inbox & Portal Management: Monitor and process daily PropertyMe inbox inquiries, tenant applications (Reapit / 2Apply / 
), and Flatmates listings.

- QLD RTA Documentation: Accurately issue, double-check, and send out Entry Notices, breach notices, lease renewals, and RTA forms with zero errors.

- Virtual Handovers & Access Codes: Carefully verify and issue key/access codes to moving tenants following strict security playbooks.

- Inspection & Routine Processing: Review and format 360 AI virtual tour reports via Inspection Express and prepare outgoing tenant summaries.

- Property Manager Support: Assist on-ground Senior Property Managers in Townsville and SEQ/Buderim with ad-hoc administrative requests, maintenance logging, and owner updates.



Compensation & On-Call Structure

- Base Salary: $1,500 – $1,700 AUD per month (paid monthly via Wise based on tracked hours via Hubstaff).

- After-Hours Call-Out Pay: $15.00 AUD (~$10.00 USD) per hour (minimum 1-hour pay block per call-out event) for urgent after-hours tenant/maintenance calls.

- Performance Bonuses: Quarterly bonuses tied to portfolio retention, error-free execution, and system adherence.



How to Apply & Hiring Process

If you are a tech-literate, systemized Property Management VA who takes pride in flawless execution, we want to hear from you.



To demonstrate your attention to detail, your application must strictly follow these instructions:



1. Application Requirements

- Subject Line: Must be exact: I am your next QLD Property Management VA - [Your Full Name]

- First Sentence: Your cover letter must start with the exact phrase:

  "I have absolute attention to detail and zero-error accuracy."

- In Your Message, Confirm & Summarize:

  - Your direct, recent experience with PropertyMe, Inspection Express, and Queensland RTA legislation.

  - Confirmation that you own an iPad, personal computer, backup power bank, and secondary backup internet connection.

  - Confirmation of your full availability for AEST business hours and after-hours call-outs.

- Loom Video Requirement: Include a link to a 60-to-90-second Loom or Google Drive video introducing yourself, outlining your QLD real estate experience, and explaining why you are the most reliable fit for our remote team.



Note: Applications that miss the exact subject line, mandatory first sentence, hardware confirmations, or Loom video link will be automatically filtered out and rejected.



2. Our Hiring Process

We respect your time and aim for a fast, clear recruitment experience:

- Application Review: Candidates who follow all instructions above will be prioritized and are guaranteed a response.

- Initial Screening Call (15 mins): A quick phone/video catch-up to review experience and alignment.

- Practical Tech Audit (15 mins): A brief, hands-on scenario in PropertyMe to verify platform fluency.

- Formal Offer: Onboarding and contract setup.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA & COMMUNITY MANAGER - USA EXPRESS

SOCIAL MEDIA & COMMUNITY MANAGER - USA EXPRESS

=============================================



...Do you spend way too much time on TikTok,
, Instagram and Reels?



...Do you see a random 15-second phone video and immediately think:



"I could make something good out of that."



If yes, keep reading.



This might actually be a fun job. :)



---

USA Express is a brand-new Philippine e-commerce business bringing authentic products directly from the United States to customers in the Philippines.



Our website - 
 - is being completed now and expected to launch in 1-2 weeks. 



Our social media? Basically a blank canvas.



That's where YOU come in.



---

We are looking for someone to take ownership of the social media and community side of USA Express LONG-TERM.



You will help build the brand from the beginning.



Not just post things.



BUILD IT.

, Instagram and TikTok pages

> > Watch trends and identify content opportunities



> > Track what performs and what our audience actually cares about



> > Help grow USA Express from ZERO followers into a real online community



---

Our founder is flying to the United States on August 25 for a month-long USA Express sourcing trip.



This will give you LOTS of real content:



> > Walmart



> > Target



> > Trader Joe's



> > CVS and Walgreens



> > Outlet stores



> > Product discoveries



> > Shopping footage



> > Suitcase packing



> > Balikbayan boxes



> > "Should we bring this home?" polls



> > New product reveals

But this trip is only Campaign #1.



After that come product drops, holiday campaigns, new arrivals, creator collaborations, promotions and everything else that comes with growing an e-commerce brand.



---



## WE'RE PROBABLY A MATCH IF...



> > You genuinely LOVE social media



> > You understand TikTok, Reels and
 culture



> > You know how Filipinos actually behave online



> > You can edit short-form video quickly



> > You know Canva and CapCut well



> > You write strong conversational English



> > You are comfortable talking to creators and influencers



> > You can manage comments and DMs professionally



> > You have ideas without waiting for someone to hand you every idea



> > You are organized



> > You have your own laptop and reliable internet



> > You can work independently



We are NOT looking for someone who simply waits to be told:



"Please make a
 post today."



We want someone who notices opportunities and thinks:



"That would make great content."



---



## WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



CREATIVITY | RELIABILITY | INITIATIVE | GOOD SOCIAL INSTINCTS | SPEED | ORGANIZATION | COMMUNICATION | CONSISTENCY



A fancy marketing degree is much less important to us than actually being GOOD at this.



---

Approximately 30 hours per week.



Flexible schedule.



We care more about consistent output, responsiveness and results than rigid clock-watching.



---

PHP 6,000 PER WEEK



Initial 30-day trial period.



This is intended to become a LONG-TERM role for the right person as USA Express grows.



---

Keep it simple.



Please send us:

2. Links or examples of social media content you have created



3. Tell us which social platform you are personally BEST at

What are the FIRST THREE things you would do?

USA EXPRESS



Authentic USA Finds.

Delivered to the Philippines.

 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

* Basic marketing support

* Preparing
 campaign assets

Experience in these areas is beneficial but commercial graphic design and print-production capability is our immediate priority



Essential Skills



You should have strong practical experience with:



* Adobe InDesign – essential

* Commercial print artwork preparation

* Print-ready PDF creation

* Bleed, trim, margins and resolution

* Strong written English

* Excellent attention to detail

Technical ability is important, but reliability is equally important.



We are looking for someone who:



* Pays exceptional attention to detail

* Communicates proactively

* Meets agreed deadlines

* Understands that production artwork must be technically correct, not simply visually attractive

* Wants to develop a **long-term working relationship** with an Australian business



Typical Turnaround Expectations



As a general guide:



Simple artwork amendments:Same business day where possible, generally within 2–4 working hours.



Standard artwork/design jobs:Approximately 1 business day.



Complex projects: You will review the brief and provide an estimated number of hours and turnaround time before commencing.

title: Operations / Production Manager — Small Video Editing Team (Cebu City, On-Site)

This is a people-and-operations job AND a hands-on editing job. You will run the room, and you will also edit.

- Report once a day to our team abroad — you are our person on the ground



THE 3-WEEK TARGET

What we mean by this: 3 weeks from your start date to having the office running with 3 editors actively working in it. That covers choosing the building, getting equipment set up, recruiting editors, and onboarding them — not 3 weeks until you personally walk through the door.



That said, quality matters more than hitting the number exactly. We would rather have week 4 with three good editors than week 3 with two good ones and one warm body rushed in to hit a deadline. The last two hires especially are judged on fit and quality, not just speed.



This is exactly why an existing network of editors in Cebu is a real advantage — recruiting from a cold start while also setting up an office in 3 weeks is genuinely difficult.



WHAT WE NEED

- 3+ years managing a team of people (BPO, agency, production house, or similar) — tell us the size of the team you ran

- Comfortable with project management tools (ClickUp, Trello, Asana or similar)

NICE TO HAVE

- Recruiting or hiring experience

WHAT WE OFFER

- PHP 55,000 - 70,000 per month depending on experience

- Full-time, long-term, on-site in Cebu City

- You build your own team and grow with the office as it expands



HOW TO APPLY

Put the word CEBU at the top of your reply so we know you read this ad. Then send:

1. A short note about a team you built or managed, and how many people were in it

2. Your CV and a portfolio showing your own editing work

Support internal and external audits.

Analyze business unit and company-level profitability.

Partner with department heads to improve financial accountability.

Develop frameworks for evaluating the financial impact of business decisions.

Drive initiatives that improve margins and overall financial efficiency.

Identify opportunities to automate and streamline finance operations.

Improve the quality, accessibility, and reliability of financial data.

Leverage technology and automation to increase finance efficiency and accuracy.

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing finance team.

Establish clear roles, responsibilities, KPIs, and performance expectations.

Develop the team’s technical and commercial finance capabilities.

Foster a culture of accountability, accuracy, continuous improvement, and business partnership

We're looking for a highly motivated, AI-driven Sales Manager to lead global customer acquisition and recurring revenue growth for our SaaS products — Payrun (AI-enabled HRM) and 
 (AI-enabled CRM & HelpDesk). You'll own the full B2B sales cycle end-to-end: prospecting, demos, negotiation, closing, and account growth — with real autonomy to build and run your own sales function.



This role his highly synchronized with the SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist role: https://www.onlinejobs.ph/jobseekers/job/SEO-and-Digital-Marketing-Specialist--SaaS-B2B
.



This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the CEO, with the entrepreneurial upside of running your own team as the business scales.



About Us

We build and operate a portfolio of B2B SaaS products for small and medium-sized businesses: Payrun (payroll and HR management), and 
 (All in One CRM & HelpDesk solution), with roots going back to Gain Solutions AS, a technology consultancy founded in 2011 in Norway with developers and operations team in Dhaka, Bangladesh.



We're currently consolidating our three products into two, sharpening our focus on AI-first tools that SMBs actually adopt and keep using.



About the Role

In few weeks, you will personally work through our backlog of trial signups — calling,
ing, and demoing — to diagnose exactly where and why prospects drop off before paying. We want you to have turned that diagnosis into a repeatable, documented sales process, hit a meaningful and growing number of new paid customers per month, and be ready to hire and lead the first inside sales hire(s) to scale what works.
