title: Digital Marketing EXPERT
description:
================

THE SHORT VERSION

================



You will work side by side as an executive assistant to the CEO of an Inc. 5000 performance marketing agency, turning half-formed ideas into clear plans, organized projects, and finished work.



If you already understand how paid ads, funnels,
, and CRM workflows fit together, and you are the kind of person who moves projects forward without being chased, keep reading.



If you are looking for calendar management and inbox cleanup, this is not that job...



===================

ABOUT WRK MARKETING

===================



WRK Marketing is a performance marketing agency serving ecommerce and lead generation clients across the US. We build marketing systems, launch campaigns, improve funnels, manage paid traffic, produce creative, test offers, and grow revenue for our clients. We move fast. Priorities shift. The work is real and it shifts too.



========================

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

========================



The CEO generates more ideas and priorities than any one person can execute. Your job is to catch them, structure them, and drive them to done.



In a typical week, you might:



- Take a rough concept from a voice note or a five-minute call and turn it into a scoped plan with owners, deadlines, and deliverables

- Build out and maintain projects in ClickUp, then keep them honest as things change

- Manage the agency's
 marketing calendar and coordinate the assets that feed it

- Push a funnel or landing page project forward across designers, copywriters, and media buyers

- Follow up with team members and contractors, surface what is stuck, and unblock it

- Research and evaluate a new tool, then write a short recommendation

- Clean up an internal workflow or document a process that only lives in someone's head

- Prep briefs, agendas, and materials so the CEO walks into every meeting ready



The mix changes based on what the business needs most that month. Flexibility is part of the job description.



======================

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

======================



FIRST 30 DAYS

You know our tools, our clients, our team, and our project structure. Nothing the CEO hands you gets dropped.



BY 90 DAYS

The CEO stops tracking status manually because you already know it. Projects have owners and dates. Follow-ups happen without reminders.



BY SIX MONTHS

You are catching problems before they surface and proposing solutions rather than waiting for direction. You own entire workstreams end to end.



=====================

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

=====================



REAL DIGITAL MARKETING DEPTH

You need to understand how the pieces connect: paid ads, funnels, landing pages,
 marketing, lead generation, ecommerce, CRM workflows, automation, reporting, creative strategy, and campaign planning. You should be able to sit in a strategy conversation and follow it without a glossary and be able to contribute.



EXCELLENT WRITTEN & SPOKEN COMMUNICATION

You can write a clear update in four sentences. You can explain what is done, what is blocked, what needs a decision, and what happens next. You ask sharp questions instead of guessing.



GENUINE OWNERSHIP

You follow up with people who outrank you. You chase the thing you were told about three weeks ago. You do not go quiet.



COMFORT WITH SOFTWARE

You can open a platform you have never used, figure out what it does, and be productive in it quickly.



STRONG PLUSES

Agency experience. Project management experience. Team leadership experience. Direct experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive.



======================

TOOLS YOU MIGHT TOUCH

======================



ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets), GoHighLevel or similar CRMs, Klaviyo and other
 platforms, funnel and landing page builders, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Shopify, AgencyAnalytics or similar reporting dashboards, Canva, Figma, CapCut, and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Descript, and ElevenLabs.



Hands-on experience with ClickUp, Klaviyo, GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and Shopify is a major advantage.



==========================

SCHEDULE, PAY, AND BENEFITS

==========================



- Full-time remote, Monday through Friday

- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, with a one-hour lunch (40 hours per week)

- $1,500/month to start, increasing to $2,500/month on successful completion of the 90-day probationary period

- 13th month pay after 6 months

- Paid holidays

- Flexible paid time off, approved in advance with the CEO

- Direct, daily access to the CEO of a growing Inc. 5000 agency

- A clear path into broader responsibility and ownership as you prove yourself



Please only apply if you can consistently work Eastern Time hours and the starting pay works for you.



==============

HOW TO APPLY

==============



Send all three of the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



1. YOUR RESUME

2. PROOF OF WORK

Portfolio, case studies, project examples, campaign results, or anything that shows what you have actually built or run.

3. A PERSONALIZED VIDEO INTRODUCTION, 2 TO 4 MINUTES



ABOUT THE VIDEO

Do not read from a script. We are not evaluating your polish, we are evaluating how you think and how you communicate. A phone camera or laptop camera in a quiet room is completely fine.



Cover these points:



- Your name and your digital marketing background

- Agency experience, if you have it

- Project management or leadership experience, if you have it

- The types of marketing projects you have personally helped manage or execute

- The tools and platforms you have worked in

- WHY SHOULD WE HIRE YOU?? PITCH YOURSELF.



================================

BEFORE YOU APPLY - PLEASE READ THIS

================================



This role asks for real commitment.



Most weeks are a normal 40 hours. Some are not. When a launch is live, a client deadline is on the line, or something breaks, there will be long days and the occasional weekend. We need someone who steps up in those moments instead of going quiet.



We are telling you this now because we would rather lose you today than in month three.



What you get in return is real. You will work directly with the CEO of a multi-million dollar performance marketing agency and see how the entire business actually runs: client strategy, sales, operations, hiring, and growth. That is an education you cannot buy, and it does not exist in a role where you are managing one channel for one brand.



Your pay moves to $2,500/month at 90 days. After that, your ceiling is set by the impact and value you bring, not by a job title. The people who grow fastest here are the ones who took on more before anyone asked them to.



If this sounds like the role you have been waiting for APPLY TODAY!!

title: DM Appointment setter
description:
# DM Appointment Setter – Instagram, TikTok &



MESSAGE ME ON 
 (317)
## About the Role



I am looking for a motivated and experienced **DM Appointment Setter** to join my online fitness coaching business.



You will be responsible for managing conversations across my **Instagram, TikTok, and
 accounts**, identifying qualified prospects, starting genuine conversations, following up with leads, and ultimately converting qualified prospects into **booked sales calls**.



This is NOT just a copy-and-paste messaging position. I need someone who can communicate naturally, understand people, ask good questions, recognize buying signals, overcome basic objections, and move conversations toward a booked call without sounding pushy or robotic.



## Your Main Goal



**Turn social media conversations into qualified booked appointments.**



New Lead ? Conversation ? Qualification ? Follow-Up ? Booked Call



## Responsibilities



* Manage DMs across Instagram, TikTok, and

* Reach out to new followers and potential prospects

* Respond to inbound leads and people engaging with our content

* Start conversations naturally without immediately pitching

* Build rapport and uncover the prospect's goals and struggles

* Qualify prospects before booking calls

* Follow up consistently with leads who stop responding

* Re-engage older leads

* Keep conversations and follow-ups organized

* Track leads and booked appointments

* Learn our offer, ideal client, messaging, and sales process



## Who We Help



Our coaching primarily helps **busy men 35+ who want to lose weight, improve their health, increase their energy, regain confidence, and become more consistent with fitness despite demanding careers and schedules.**



Qualified leads typically have a clear fitness or weight-loss goal, recognize they need help, are ready to make a change, and are willing and able to invest in professional coaching.



## What I DON'T Want



Please do not apply if your strategy is:



* Sending hundreds of identical copy-and-paste messages

* Immediately pitching people

* Sounding like a bot

* Booking anyone who agrees to a call

* Ignoring follow-ups

* Being overly aggressive

* Focusing on DM volume instead of results



I care about **qualified conversations and booked appointments**, not meaningless activity.



## Ideal Candidate



You would be a great fit if you:



* Have DM setting or appointment-setting experience

* Understand sales conversations

* Write and speak excellent English

* Can communicate naturally with American prospects

* Understand rapport and qualification

* Are comfortable handling basic objections

* Are organized with follow-ups

* Take coaching and feedback well

* Are reliable and consistent

* Are motivated by performance



Experience with **online coaching, fitness, high-ticket sales, or social media sales** is a major plus.



## Performance



Your performance will primarily be measured by:



* Meaningful conversations

* Qualified leads

* Qualified calls booked

* Follow-up consistency

* Appointment show rate

* Quality of appointments

* Sales generated from your appointments



**Booked calls alone are not enough.** Quality matters.



## 3-Day Trial Period



The **first 3 days will be a trial period** to determine whether you can effectively handle the position, follow our system, communicate properly with prospects, stay organized, and produce quality conversations.



During these three days, I will be evaluating your:



* Communication skills

* Ability to follow instructions

* Work ethic and consistency

* DM conversation quality

* Qualification ability

* Follow-up

* Overall fit for the position



If you successfully complete the trial and demonstrate that you can handle the role, **we will move forward into the ongoing paid position.**



I am looking for someone who wants to earn a long-term position, not someone looking for something temporary.



## How to Apply



Please start your application with:



**“I READ THE FULL POST.”**



Then answer these **5 questions:**



1. What experience do you have with DM setting or appointment setting, and what types of businesses have you worked with?

2. What platforms have you used, and approximately how many qualified appointments were you booking per week?

3. How do you determine whether a prospect is qualified before booking them for a sales call?

4. How would you respond to a prospect who says, **“I know what I need to do, I just need to be more consistent”?**

5. What hours are you available, what is your expected hourly rate, and why do you believe you would be a good fit for this position?



Please also send a **short voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining your previous appointment-setting experience.



**Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.**

title: Credit Repair fullfiment operation lead (white label)
description:
Karia Growth Solutions provides private-label / white-label backend fulfillment for credit repair companies. Our business partners keep their own brand, sales process, and client relationships. Our fulfillment desk supports the documented back-office workflow: secure intake coordination, case tracking, approved dispute-workflow production, quality control, reporting, and partner-ready client updates.



We are not hiring a general virtual assistant. We are hiring an experienced operations leader who can help us run a secure, repeatable, detail-oriented fulfillment desk under the Karia Growth Solutions brand.



This role does not involve promising client outcomes, score increases, deletions, financing approvals, or fixed credit-reporting timelines. We work only within approved company SOPs, documented workflows, and assigned responsibilities.



The opportunity



You will own the daily operations rhythm for a growing private-label fulfillment desk. You will organize queues, protect quality, keep cases moving, prepare clear Slack updates, and help create a system that can support multiple partner companies without confusion or missed steps.



You will report directly to the Founder / Partner Success Lead. You will not communicate directly with Karia’s business partners unless specifically authorized for an internal meeting. All partner-owner communication, scope changes, escalations, pricing, approvals, and relationship management remain with Karia’s Founder / Partner Success Lead.



Core responsibilities



You will manage and improve the internal workflow for partner-specific case queues. This includes checking that every assigned file has the required documents, assigning and tracking work, maintaining accurate statuses, identifying delays, and escalating incomplete or unusual files through the approved process.



You will supervise or coordinate the internal production team responsible for case-workflow production, client onboarding support, reporting, and tracking. You will verify that all work follows Karia’s approved SOPs and templates before it is marked complete.



You will build a dependable communication rhythm in Slack. Every business day, you will post a concise internal operations update that covers completed work, blocked files, missing documents, quality-control items, priorities for the next shift, and any decisions needed from the Founder. You will keep information organized in the correct partner channel and never move consumer information into personal chats,
 accounts, or unapproved tools.



You will prepare partner-ready weekly reports using approved templates. Reports must be clear, accurate, factual, and free of promises about score changes, deletions, approvals, or timing.



You will help document and continuously improve workflows for intake, production, QA, reporting, security, and escalation. You will help onboard additional internal team members after the process is proven.



What you will not do



You will not make legal claims or offer legal advice. You will not promise, imply, or guarantee any credit-reporting outcome. You will not make up dispute reasons, submit unsupported information, or tell anyone that accurate information will be removed.



You will not directly negotiate pricing, approve scope changes, bill partners, or take partner-owner communications outside the approved Karia channel. You will not share passwords, use personal storage for work files, use personal WhatsApp for case data, or download consumer documents to an unapproved device or location.



Required experience



You have at least two years of experience in credit repair operations, credit-report workflow support, financial-services back-office operations, or a highly comparable document-heavy case-management environment. You have experience working with client files, task queues, SOPs, trackers, quality-control checklists, and recurring reporting.



You have used Slack daily in a professional operations environment and can write brief, clear, action-oriented updates. You are comfortable with spreadsheets, Google Workspace, project-management tools, CRM-style pipelines, and documenting work in a consistent format.



You communicate fluently in written English, are highly organized, notice missing information quickly, and can follow strict process rules. You are comfortable raising a blocker instead of guessing.



Previous experience managing remote team members, reviewing work for quality, or building SOPs is strongly preferred.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Maison Cosmetics is a fast-growing DTC skincare brand focused on premium, ingredient-led products for women 40+. We launched in the DACH market in January and have already converted more than 100,000 customers. We recently opened the US and our next phase is to keep growing steadily in DACH while cracking and scaling the US.



Creative is the engine behind our growth. Paid social is our main acquisition channel and we are scaling across Meta, TikTok, Google and other channels. We produce a high volume of creative every week, supported by an AI-driven production team.



The role



We are looking for a Senior Creative Strategist who owns the creative pipeline end to end: from research and angle development, to scripts and briefs, to clear visual direction for our production team, to reading performance data and d
 what gets iterated next.



This is not a copywriting role and not a designer role. You are the person who d
 what we say, to whom, and why it will convert.



What you will do



Develop new direct response angles based on customer research, survey data, reviews and competitor intelligence

Write high-converting scripts.



Brief and give clear visual direction to our AI-driven production team

Build and maintain a testing roadmap: hooks, angles, formats, hierarchy of what to test next

Analyze creative performance and turn learnings into the next round of concepts

Localize and adapt winning concepts across DACH and US markets



Who we are looking for



3+ years of hands-on creative strategy for DTC brands with meaningful paid social spend

Proven track record of concepts that scaled, ideally in beauty, skincare, supplements or health

You think in angles and mechanisms, not in taglines

Strong writing in English, native-level tone for the US market

Comfortable working from data: post-purchase surveys, reviews, ad account performance

Fast, high volume, iterative. You would rather ship ten concepts and learn than polish one for a week

Self-directed. You bring the roadmap, we do not hand you a task list



What we offer



Full ownership of creative strategy for a brand that is already scaling, not a startup looking for product market fit

Long-term, full-time contract with room to grow into creative leadership as we expand internationally

Performance-based bonus on top of your base rate

Direct line to the founders, no layers, decisions made same day

Real budget behind your ideas, so your work gets tested at scale within days



Details



Type: long-term contract, full-time (40 hours per week)

Location: fully remote



How to apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, include the following:



Two or three ads you personally conceptualized that scaled. Tell us the angle behind each one and why you believe it worked.

One angle you would test for us in week one, in three sentences. Look at our brand first: 

Your availability and your rate.



Applications without a specific angle in point 2 will not be reviewed.

title: Retail Design Support - Fixture Development
description:
Retail Design Support – Fixture Development

Tank Stream Design | Part-time | Remote | 2–3 days per week

About Us

At Tank Stream Design we live to explore out and to help people experience the world. For over 25 years we have successfully designed and created apparel, hats, sunglasses and accessories that support everyone in their travel and adventures in nature.

We are looking for a technically minded Retail Design Support person to join our team on a part-time basis, supporting the development, documentation and production of retail fixtures and merchandising systems.

This role is focused on the detail between design concept and finished product — turning ideas, sketches and existing designs into accurate drawings, specifications and practical documentation that can be confidently manufactured, assembled and rolled out.

You will work remotely as part of our Retail Design and Visual Merchandising team, collaborating with internal stakeholders and external suppliers, across our suite of brands.

The Role

The Retail Design Support role will be responsible for supporting the technical development and documentation of retail fixtures, displays and merchandising systems.

You will help take concepts and briefs through to production-ready drawings, specifications and visual guides, while also supporting the creation of planograms, assembly instructions and sales tools.

This role would suit an Industrial Designer, Retail Fixture Designer, Product Designer or technically skilled Retail Designer who enjoys understanding how things are made and solving practical design problems.

Key Responsibilities

Fixture Design & Development

• Develop and refine retail fixtures, displays, stands and merchandising systems from concept through to production.

• Translate sketches, concepts, measurements and visual references into accurate CAD drawings and 3D models.

• Develop practical design solutions that consider materials, manufacturing, assembly, packaging and installation.

• Support the development of modular and repeatable retail fixture systems.

• Review existing fixtures and identify opportunities to improve functionality, construction and efficiency.

• Refine designs based on prototypes, samples, supplier feedback and testing.

Technical Documentation

• Produce detailed CAD drawings including plans, elevations, sections, details and component drawings.

• Prepare production-ready drawings and specifications for suppliers and manufacturers.

• Document materials, finishes, hardware, fixings, dimensions and assembly requirements.

• Prepare clear build notes and production instructions.

• Maintain organised drawing files, templates, specifications and revision control.

• Check drawings and documentation for accuracy, completeness and buildability.

Visual Guides & Sales Tools

• Create clear visual assembly and installation guides for suppliers, sales teams and field teams.

• Develop planograms and merchandising layouts that clearly communicate fixture and product configuration.

• Assist with the creation of Visual Merchandising and fixture standards.

• Develop simple diagrams and visual instructions that can be easily understood by non-technical users.

• Support the creation of sales tools and presentation materials for retail fixture solutions.

Production & Supplier Support

• Prepare and issue production-ready documentation to suppliers and manufacturers.

• Work with suppliers to clarify drawings and resolve technical questions.

• Support prototype and sample reviews and incorporate feedback into final documentation.

• Identify potential production or assembly issues and propose practical solutions.

• Help ensure finished fixtures meet design, specification and functional requirements.

Systems & Continuous Improvement

• Maintain organised libraries of fixture drawings, components, hardware and specifications.

• Support the development and maintenance of retail fixture standards and systems.

• Contribute to improving documentation templates, workflows and design processes.

• Help develop scalable systems that make future fixture development, production and rollout more efficient.

About You

We are open to the right person and value technical capability, practical thinking and attention to detail as much as years of experience.

You will ideally have:

• A qualification in Industrial Design, Product Design, Retail Design, Interior Architecture or a related discipline.

• Experience designing, developing or documenting retail fixtures, displays, furniture, products or similar physical systems.

• Strong CAD and technical drawing skills, with SketchUp experience highly regarded.

• An understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, construction methods and hardware.

• The ability to read and interpret technical and construction drawings.

• An understanding of how a design moves from concept through prototype, production and installation.

• Experience preparing production drawings and documentation for suppliers or manufacturers.

• Strong visual communication skills and the ability to make technical information easy to understand.

• Experience creating planograms, assembly guides, installation guides or similar documentation is highly regarded.

• Practical knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft 365.

• Excellent communication skills, with fluency in written and spoken English 

• A highly organised, methodical and detail-oriented approach.

• The ability to work independently while communicating clearly with a remote Australian based team.

• A practical, solutions-focused mindset and willingness to investigate and solve problems.

• The ability to manage deadlines and multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

Working Arrangement

This is a part-time remote role, working 2–3 days per week. 

Working days and core hours will be agreed in advance and maintained on a consistent weekly schedule, providing reliable availability for collaboration with the wider Retail Design, VM and Production teams.

The role will primarily align with Australian East Coast business hours, with occasional communication required with our international teams and suppliers.

Why Join Tank Stream Design?

• Work on real, physical retail environments and fixtures experienced by our customers around the world.

• Be part of a growing, design-led business with strong momentum.

• Work remotely as an integrated part of an experienced creative and retail team.

• Work across the full journey from design concept to manufactured fixture.

• Have a direct impact on how our retail fixtures are designed, produced and rolled out.

• Help develop practical systems and documentation that improve how our retail environments are delivered globally.

Apply Now

If you are a technically minded designer who enjoys solving practical problems, understanding how things are made and turning ideas into clear, production-ready documentation, we’d love to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV, a short cover letter and portfolio showcasing relevant industrial design, product design, retail fixture or technical design work.

title: Software QA Tester – Mobile Apps & Web
description:
Job Overview



We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented Software QA Tester to join our international team on a full-time remote basis.



You will be responsible for testing iOS and Android applications, websites, and web-based products. Your main goal is to identify bugs, verify product requirements, and ensure that every release is stable, user-friendly, and ready for launch.



Responsibilities



1. Test iOS and Android applications, websites, and web-based products.

2. Review product requirements, UI designs, and user flows before testing.

3. Create and execute test plans, test scenarios, checklists, and test cases.

4. Perform functional, UI, usability, compatibility, regression, and exploratory testing.

5. Test applications across different devices, operating systems, screen sizes, languages, and network conditions.

6. Verify that the developed product matches the requirements, Figma designs, and expected interactions.

7. Identify, reproduce, and report bugs with clear descriptions, reproduction steps, screenshots, videos, device details, and severity levels.

8. Track reported bugs and conduct regression testing after fixes are completed.

9. Test important user flows, including registration, login, subscriptions, in-app purchases, payments, content creation, file uploads, downloads, and account management.

10. Check for crashes, slow loading, broken layouts, incorrect content, data errors, and other stability issues.

11. Conduct final quality checks before submitting applications to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

12. Verify app icons, screenshots, descriptions, permissions, privacy links, subscription information, and other store-listing details.

13. Test production versions after release and help verify issues reported by users.

14. Work remotely with product managers, UI/UX designers, and developers to resolve issues efficiently.

15. Prepare clear test reports, release checklists, and quality summaries.

16. Attend online meetings and provide regular updates on testing progress, risks, and unresolved issues.



Requirements



1. Previous experience in software testing, mobile app testing, website testing, or a related QA role.

2. Good understanding of iOS, Android, and web application testing processes.

3. Ability to independently create test cases, execute tests, and prepare clear test reports.

4. Experience with functional, compatibility, regression, usability, and exploratory testing.

5. Strong ability to identify, reproduce, document, and communicate software issues.

6. Ability to compare the implemented product with requirements and Figma designs.

7. Strong attention to detail, patience, and a responsible working attitude.

8. Familiarity with bug-tracking or project-management tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Trello, TAPD, or similar platforms.

9. Ability to provide complete bug reports with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, screen recordings, device information, and expected results.

10. Basic knowledge of App Store and Google Play release processes is preferred.

11. Experience testing subscriptions, in-app purchases, payment flows, and third-party login systems is preferred.

12. Familiarity with tools such as Postman, Charles Proxy, Fiddler, Android Studio, or Xcode is an advantage.

13. Experience with API, performance, or automated testing is an advantage.

14. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet deadlines in a remote environment.

15. Good written and spoken English for daily communication with an international team.

16. A reliable internet connection and personal computer are required.

17. Must be available during the working hours agreed with the company.



Preferred Qualifications



1. Experience testing consumer mobile applications from development through final release.

2. Experience testing subscription-based, utility, photo, video, or content-creation applications.

3. Experience assisting with App Store or Google Play review and compliance issues.

4. Basic ability to review API responses, crash reports, application logs, or device logs.

5. Basic knowledge of automated testing tools or scripting is a plus.



Employment Details



* Employment Type: Full-time

* Work Arrangement: Fully remote

* Position Type: Long-term

* Location: Southeast Asia

* Communication Language: English

* Working Hours: Based on the company’s agreed time zone and schedule



Application Requirements



Please provide the following information when applying:



1. Your updated CV or résumé.

2. A short introduction about your QA or software-testing experience.

3. Examples of mobile applications or websites you have tested.

4. The devices you currently own for testing, including phone models and operating-system versions.

5. The testing and project-management tools you have used.

6. Your current location and time zone.

7. Your English proficiency level.

8. Your expected monthly salary.

9. Your earliest available start date.

title: Revenue-Driven Content & Conversion Strategist
description:
Event Marketing | Engagement | High-CTA Content | Conversion



Remote | Performance-Based | Revenue + Commission



We are hiring a Revenue-Driven Content & Conversion Strategist to build momentum, engagement, demand, and ultimately ticket sales for a major 2027 Early Childhood Education implementation summit.



This is NOT a traditional Social Media Manager position.



We are not looking for someone whose primary focus is posting consistently, making graphics, increasing followers, or filling a content calendar.



 This position has a revenue objective.



Your content should cause people to:



STOP ? ENGAGE ? RESPOND ? CLICK ? INQUIRE ? BUY



We need someone who understands how to take a movement, event, founder, speakers, industry problems, partnerships, solutions, and ticket offer and build a strategic content campaign that converts attention into action and action into revenue.



YOUR FIRST MISSION: BUILD MOMENTUM



Your first major assignment will be developing and executing a complete 30-Day Event Momentum & Conversion Campaign.



We do NOT want 30 random social media posts.



We want a strategically sequenced campaign where every piece of content has an objective.



You will develop:



* Educational authority content

* High-CTA conversion content

* Bold and controversial conversation starters

* Industry pain-point content

* Polls and audience questions

* Founder-led video concepts and scripts

* Short-form video/Reel concepts

* Speaker/session tie-ins

* Partner and sponsor spotlights

* Behind-the-scenes content

* Implementation challenges

* Audience participation campaigns

* Community engagement posts

* Social proof content

* Ticket-focused campaigns

* Urgency and scarcity messaging

* Lead-generation content

* Retargeting/reactivation concepts

* Direct-response CTAs



The goal is to intentionally move our audience through:



ATTENTION ? ENGAGEMENT ? INTEREST ? INTENT ? CONVERSION ? REVENUE



 THIS ROLE IS MEASURED DIFFERENTLY



We are not hiring someone simply to report:



"We posted 25 times this month."



"Engagement increased."



"We gained 300 followers."



Those numbers may matter, but they are not the finish line.



We want to know:



How many people took action?



How many qualified conversations did the content generate?



How many people clicked?



How many entered the ticket pipeline?



How many converted?



How much attributable revenue did the campaign generate?



 Activity alone is not performance.



YOUR SCORECARD



Performance will be evaluated through measurable indicators including:



* Content-generated leads

* CTA responses

* Qualified DMs/conversations

* Landing-page/ticket-page traffic

* Link clicks

* Ticket inquiries

* Ticket purchases

* Conversion rate

* Audience reactivation

* Campaign-attributed revenue

* Revenue generated from organic content

* Engagement that progresses into the sales pipeline



 COMPENSATION



This is a performance-driven revenue and commission-based opportunity.



Compensation is designed around measurable conversion and revenue performance.



The stronger your content performs and the more attributable revenue your campaigns help generate, the greater your earning opportunity.



This opportunity is best suited for someone who is confident in their ability to produce more than vanity metrics.



If you need guaranteed compensation regardless of campaign performance, this may not be the right opportunity for you.



If you understand direct-response marketing, conversion content and performance-based compensation—and you're confident you can help turn attention into revenue—we want to talk to you.



 WHO WE NEED



You may have experience as a:



* Content Marketing Strategist

* Conversion Copywriter

* Direct-Response Content Strategist

* Event Marketing Strategist

* Social Media Conversion Strategist

* Organic Growth Strategist

* Community Conversion Strategist



Your exact previous title matters less than your ability to produce measurable results.



You should understand:



Content Strategy



How individual pieces of content work together as part of a larger campaign.



Direct-Response Copywriting



How to write hooks, build tension, communicate value, overcome objections and create strong CTAs.



Conversion



How to move an audience from passive consumption into measurable action.



Event Marketing



How to build anticipation and demand around a future live experience.



Community Engagement



How to create conversations rather than simply broadcast information.



Buyer Psychology



How awareness, pain, desire, urgency, trust and social proof influence purchasing decisions.



Analytics



How to determine what's working, what's not and what needs to change.



 YOU MUST BE ABLE TO THINK BEYOND ONE POST



If we tell you:



 “ECE school owners are struggling with staffing, leadership accountability, payroll, funding and outdated technology.”



We expect you to immediately begin thinking:



What's the strongest hook?



What conversation could we start?



What's the founder video?



What's the poll?



What's the controversial angle?



Which speaker connects to the problem?



Which partner provides a solution?



What's the lead-generation opportunity?



What's the CTA?



How do we move the engaged person toward purchasing a ticket?



That's the level of strategic thinking this position requires.



FIRST 30-DAY DELIVERABLE



You will develop and execute a 30-Day Event Momentum & Conversion Campaign, including:



* 30-day strategic content calendar

* Daily content concepts

* Finished captions/copy

* High-impact hooks

* Content objectives

* Recommended formats

* Founder video scripts/topics

* Engagement questions

* Polls

* Speaker integrations

* Partner integrations

* Behind-the-scenes concepts

* Implementation challenges

* Lead-generation opportunities

* High-CTA conversion posts

* Ticket-sales CTAs

* Weekly conversion review

* Campaign optimization recommendations



Every piece of content should answer:



 What do we want this person to DO next?



HOW TO APPLY



Generic applications will not be considered.



Please provide:



1. A brief introduction explaining your experience with conversion-focused content, direct-response marketing, event marketing, lead generation or revenue-producing social media.



2. Three examples of content or campaigns you personally created or strategized.



3. At least one example of a campaign where your work contributed to leads, registrations, purchases or revenue.



Numbers matter.



Whenever possible, include:



Audience Size ? Campaign ? Leads/Clicks ? Conversions ? Revenue



4. Explain how you determine whether content is producing business results rather than vanity metrics.



5. Tell us about your experience working under a performance/commission-based compensation structure.



 REQUIRED MINI ASSIGNMENT



We want to evaluate how you THINK.



Imagine you are marketing a major Early Childhood Education implementation summit.



The central message is:



The industry has talked about its problems long enough. It's time to start implementing solutions.



Create three concepts:



 A. CONVERSATION



One bold post designed to generate meaningful discussion.



 B. FOUNDER VIDEO



One short-form founder video/Reel concept.



 C. CONVERSION



One high-CTA post designed to move an engaged follower closer to purchasing a ticket.



For each provide:



HOOK ? CONTENT IDEA ? CTA ? DESIRED ACTION



Do not spend more than 20–30 minutes completing this assignment.



We aren't evaluating graphic design.



We're evaluating your ability to create:



ATTENTION.

CONVERSATION.

ACTION.

CONVERSION.

REVENUE.



 ONE FINAL QUESTION



Finish your application by answering:



 If you had 30 days to turn an engaged but non-buying audience into paying event attendees, what would you do first—and why?



We are looking for someone who doesn't wake up asking:



What should I post today?



We want someone who asks:



 “What does the audience need to see, hear, believe or experience today that will move them closer to taking action?”



If you understand that difference, we want to hear from you.

• Excellent English communication skills—both written and spoken.

Schedule

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

How We Work

title: Creative & Community Production Specialist
description:
Creative & Community Production Specialist



Role Mission



Bring it to market.



We are seeking a Creative & Community Production Specialist who can take approved ideas, campaigns, offers, promotions, partnerships, and revenue initiatives and turn them into polished, market-ready creative assets.



This is not simply a graphic design or social media posting position.



We need someone who understands how creative production supports visibility, engagement, lead generation, calls-to-action, launches, and revenue.



You will work from established strategy and direction and be responsible for turning that direction into finished creative that is ready to deploy.







 What You Will Own



 Campaign Creative Production



Produce the creative assets required to execute marketing and revenue campaigns, including:



 Social media graphics

* Carousels

* Promotional graphics

* Campaign banners

* Story graphics

* Reels/video covers

* Countdown content

* Announcement graphics

* Educational content

* CTA graphics

* Offer graphics

* Deadline and urgency content

* Campaign templates



You should be able to receive a campaign brief and understand what needs to be created to successfully bring that campaign to market.







 Sales & Conversion Assets



Create materials designed to support lead generation and conversion, including:



* Sales graphics

* Promotional flyers

* Digital brochures

* Lead magnets

* Sales PDFs

* One-sheets

* Pricing graphics

* Offer graphics

* Testimonial graphics

* FAQ content

* Bonus graphics

* Registration or purchase CTAs

* Affiliate/promotional materials

* Partnership collateral



Creative must do more than look good.



It must help move the audience toward action.







 Launch Production



Support launches from beginning to end.



This may include:



Pre-Launch



* Awareness content

* Teasers

* Educational content

* Conversation starters

* Polls

* Countdown graphics

* Waitlist or interest-building materials



Launch



* Announcement creative

* Promotional content

* Sales graphics

* CTA materials

* Stories

* Reels/video assets

* Testimonials

* Promotional documents



Closing



* Deadline graphics

* Urgency content

* Final-call posts

* Last-chance CTAs

* Closing-day creative



You should understand how the creative changes throughout different stages of a campaign.







 Community Content Production



Create content that keeps online communities active, engaged, informed, and moving toward meaningful action.



Content may include:



* Conversation starters

* Polls

* Educational posts

* Implementation challenges

* Community announcements

* Member spotlights

* Resource graphics

* Celebration posts

* Event or training reminders

* Lead magnet promotions

* CTA posts

* Offer-related content



Community content should intentionally move audiences through:



Attention ? Engagement ? Trust ? Action ? Conversion







 Partner, Contributor & Promotional Assets



Develop professional, shareable promotional materials for external collaborators and contributors.



This may include:



* Promotional kits

* Personalized graphics

* Partnership announcements

* Contributor spotlights

* Social media templates

* Story templates

* Co-branded graphics

* Promotional PDFs

* Campaign-specific assets

* Affiliate promotional materials



You will also be expected to maintain organized asset folders so approved materials can be quickly located and distributed.







Formatting & Visual Execution



Transform raw information into polished, professional, branded materials.



Projects may include:



* PDFs

* Workbooks

* Assessments

* Guides

* Checklists

* Presentations

* Training materials

* Worksheets

* Lead magnets

* Reports

* One-sheets

* Digital resources



Strong attention to typography, spacing, alignment, hierarchy, readability, and overall visual presentation is required.







 This Is NOT a Passive Design Position



We are not looking for someone who needs to be told:



"Make a flyer."



We are looking for someone who can receive:



"Here is the campaign. Here is the audience. Here is the offer. Here is the CTA. Here is the timeline."



…and determine what creative assets need to be produced to execute it.



We need someone who thinks in terms of campaigns—not isolated graphics.







 Required Skills



Strong proficiency or demonstrated experience in:



* Canva

* Graphic design

* Social media creative production

* Campaign production

* Content repurposing

* Visual storytelling

* Marketing collateral

* Lead magnet creation

* Document/PDF formatting

* Short-form video editing

* Social media content formatting

* File and asset organization

* Brand consistency

* Project management

* Deadline management

* Quality control



Experience with CRM platforms, social scheduling tools, Google Workspace, project-management software, and AI-assisted creative tools is a plus.







 Who We're Looking For



You should be:



* Creative

* Fast

* Highly organized

* Detail-oriented

* Deadline-driven

* Resourceful

* Coachable

* Comfortable receiving feedback

* Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously

* Able to follow established brand guidelines

* Able to work from campaign briefs and directives

* Able to anticipate what assets will be needed

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

* Interested in marketing, community building, and revenue—not design alone



You should understand that:



Creative is not decoration. Creative is part of the revenue engine.







 Performance Expectations



This is an **outcome-driven role



Performance will be evaluated based on areas such as:



* Creative deliverables completed

* On-time completion rate

* Campaign readiness

* Turnaround time

* Quality of execution

* Brand consistency

* Community content production

* Revenue-supporting assets produced

* Accuracy

* Revision rate

* Organization of creative assets

* Ability to execute with limited hand-holding



Performance Standard



95%+ of assigned creative deliverables should be completed accurately and by deadline with minimal revisions.



Campaigns should not be delayed because required creative materials were not ready.







 The Person We Need



We need someone who sees a strong idea and immediately starts thinking:



What needs to be created?



What does the audience need to see?



What assets will support the CTA?



What needs to be ready before this goes live?*



How do we turn this into something people will stop, notice, engage with, and act on?



If you are someone who can take direction and transform it into organized, polished, high-converting creative execution, this may be the right role for you.



 Core Outcome



Take the strategy. Build the assets. Support the campaign. Bring it to market.

title: Real Estate Inside Sales Associate (ISA) – Full-Time
description:
We are a growing independent real estate brokerage in Texas looking for an experienced Real Estate Inside Sales Associate (ISA) to join our team full-time.



This is not an entry-level VA or administrative position. Your primary responsibility is to create conversations, identify opportunities, nurture leads, and turn prospects into qualified appointments for our real estate agents.



We are specifically looking for someone with extensive experience in U.S. residential real estate, real estate lead conversion, cold calling, database management, CRM organization, and appointment setting.



What You'll Be Doing



Your primary responsibility will be working and converting our existing and new lead database through consistent outbound calling, texting,
, and systematic follow-up.



You will:



-Work a large aged real estate database and identify buyers and sellers who are ready to re-engage.-

-Prospect expired and withdrawn listings and convert homeowners into listing appointments.

-Call expired rental listings to identify potential sales and property management opportunities.

-Respond quickly to new inbound buyer and seller leads.

-Conduct outbound cold calling and prospecting.

-Qualify buyer and seller motivation, timeline, needs, and readiness.

-Nurture long-term prospects who aren't ready today.

-Set qualified buyer consultations and listing appointments for our agents.

-Maintain accurate notes, statuses, tags, tasks, and follow-up plans inside the CRM.

-Clean, organize, segment, and systematically work a large cold/aged database.

-Build, implement, and optimize automated lead-nurture campaigns using calls, texts,
s, tasks, and other touchpoints.

-Create and manage Brivity Plans and/or Real Geeks Drip Campaigns designed to be engaging, natural, and conversion-focused.

-Evaluate existing nurture campaigns and improve messaging, timing, segmentation, and follow-up based on lead response and conversion.

-Develop and follow scripts while communicating naturally and confidently.

-Develop and document business processes related to the ISA role for future ISAs as we are a growing team.

-Understand when the lead could be a buyer, a listing, a property management opportunity or an investment opportunity.



What We're Looking For



Extensive U.S. real estate experience is required.



The ideal candidate has previous experience as a:



Real Estate ISA

Real Estate Appointment Setter

Real Estate Inside Sales Representative

Real Estate Lead Manager

Real Estate Cold Caller / Prospector

Lead Conversion Specialist for a real estate team or brokerage



You should already understand buyer leads, seller leads, expired listings, listing appointments, buyer consultations, lead nurture, database follow-up, lead stages, and real estate CRM pipelines.



Technology Experience



Experience with the following is a strong plus:



Brivity CRM — especially Plans and lead follow-up workflows

BrokerMint — transaction management

Buildium — property management 

Real estate dialers and calling platforms

Other major U.S. real estate CRMs and lead-management systems



**We're especially interested in candidates who have personally built or improved CRM nurture campaigns, rather than simply used campaigns created by someone else.**



The Personality We're Looking For



We need someone who is:



Highly influential and persuasive

Assertive and appropriately dominant

Confident asking for the appointment

Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

Energetic and engaging on the phone

Persistent without sounding aggressive

Comfortable handling objections and rejection

Organized and disciplined with follow-up

Analytical enough to recognize what's working and what isn't

Coachable and comfortable working from measurable KPIs

An excellent English communicator with clear, professional spoken and written English



We want someone who can build rapport quickly but is also comfortable taking control of a conversation, uncovering motivation, handling objections, and asking for the appointment.



Success in This Role



We are results-oriented. Activity is important, but the goal isn't simply to make calls.



The goal is qualified appointments and ultimately closed business.



Performance will be measured using metrics such as:

-Outbound calls and conversations

-Contact rate

-Speed-to-lead

-Follow-up completion

-Leads qualified

-Appointments set

-Appointment show rate

-Database organization and CRM accuracy

-Opportunities generated from aged and cold leads

-Nurture campaign engagement and conversion

-Leads moved from nurture into active opportunities

-Position Details



Type: Full-Time

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: Must be available during U.S. Central Time business/prospecting hours

Location: Remote

Industry: U.S. Residential Real Estate

Position: Long-term



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term member of our sales organization—not someone looking for a short-term VA assignment.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your resume highlighting your U.S. real estate experience.

A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your real estate ISA/cold-calling experience.

A list of the real estate CRMs and dialers you've used. Specifically tell us about any experience with Brivity, Real Geeks, and BrokerMint.

Describe the largest aged or cold real estate database you've personally managed or prospected.

Tell us your previous daily call volume and KPIs, including contacts and appointments set per week or month.

Briefly explain your experience calling expired listings, buyer leads, seller leads, or other cold real estate prospects.

Describe a drip campaign, Brivity Plan, or automated nurture sequence you've personally created or improved. What was the audience, what types of touches did you use, and what results did you see?

Tell us your expected monthly compensation for a full-time position.



Finally, begin your application with the words:



"I KNOW REAL ESTATE ISA"



Applications that don't include the requested information will not be considered.

title: Founding Phone Sales Closer for US Luxury Furniture. A$10/hr Base + 5% Commission Paid Weekly. Warm Leads, Night Shift.
description:
The pay: A$10/hr base (approx US$6.50/hr, approx PHP 31,000/month at 20 hrs/week) PLUS a flat 5% commission on every sale you close, uncapped, paid weekly. Plus a $300 bonus on your first close.



An established Australian furniture company with 20,000+ customers is launching its premium leather lounge brand in the US. We are hiring one closer to own our US phone leads from day one, and to grow with this market as we scale it.



How this role scales. Our US growth engine is paid ads on Meta and Google generating warm leads at whatever volume we choose to fund. Every month you close well, we increase ad spend, which means more leads on your desk, which means more commission. Your performance sets the throttle.



The commission model at every stage. Products sell for USD $4,000 to $12,000. You earn a flat 5% on every close, uncapped, paid weekly:



One $8,000 close = US$400, on top of your base, in one call

Month 1, conservative: ~$21,000 closed = ~US$1,050 commission + base = ~US$1,610 total

Month 1, on plan: ~$52,000 closed = ~US$3,185 total, more than triple a typical rate on this platform

Month 3 target: $200,000/month in US sales with up to 70% closed by phone (that is how our home market runs) = US$7,000/month in commission



At scale: this market is built to reach $500,000/month in closed revenue. At 5%, that is US$25,000/month in commission flowing through this seat. Getting there means going full-time, owning the US sales desk, and helping lead the reps hired under you. The person who starts in this chair gets first right to all of it.



These projections are backed by live ad spend and a guaranteed minimum lead volume in writing. No tiers, no caps, no games.



The role. Warm leads only. Every person you call filled out a lead form from our ads or abandoned a checkout. You call quickly, build rapport, speak passionately about a genuinely premium product, handle questions from our playbook, and close the sale or book the next step. Our top reps run this exact model in our home market and will train you personally. Dialer, CRM, scripts, and full product training provided.



Hours: 20 hrs/week to start, fixed night shift covering US business hours (approx 11pm to 7am Manila), scaling to full-time as lead volume grows. Only apply if night shift is genuinely sustainable for you.



You:



Hungry. You want income tied to ability and a seat that grows into something bigger

2+ years phone sales to US customers (real estate ISA, solar, insurance, high-ticket ecommerce are strong backgrounds)

Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent

Quiet workspace, wired internet, backup power a plus

Most of all: you can make someone genuinely want a beautiful piece of furniture, not just process them



Hiring process: application form ? call recording review ? 15-minute video interview ? paid mock sales call ? 30-day paid trial at the full rate.



To apply: complete the application form here: 
 



It requires a recording of a REAL sales call you have made (an excerpt of 2 to 5 minutes, client names muted is fine). Applications without a real call recording will not be reviewed.

title: Inbound Sales Closer, Warm Leads, $500 Base + Uncapped Commission
description:
We are looking for an empathetic and results-driven Inbound Sales Closer to join TOPSPEECH Health, a technology company building digital speech therapy programs for people who want to improve speech impediments such as lisp, rhotacism, and stuttering.



This is NOT a cold-calling role



We already generate warm inbound leads through our free online speech assessments.



These users have already shown interest in understanding or improving their speech. Your job is to take it from there.



You will speak with warm leads, understand their situation, build trust, answer questions, follow up when necessary, and ultimately convert qualified leads into paid 2-month, 4-month, or 6-month programs.



Some conversations may also involve parents, so we are looking for someone who is naturally empathetic, trustworthy, and comfortable discussing personal topics.



Your Responsibilities



• Follow up with warm inbound leads

• Conduct sales calls with prospective customers and parents

• Understand the customer's situation, goals, and concerns

• Explain our programs clearly and naturally

• Handle objections around price, urgency, commitment, and perceived need

• Follow up consistently with interested leads

• Convert qualified leads into paying customers

• Keep leads and follow-ups organized

• Track conversations and sales results

• Share useful customer feedback with our team



Who We're Looking For



You should have:



• Excellent spoken and written English

• Previous experience in sales, inbound sales, closing, telesales, or customer success

• Strong listening skills

• High emotional intelligence and empathy

• Confidence speaking with international customers

• The ability to build trust quickly

• Strong objection-handling skills

• A natural, non-pushy sales style

• Good follow-up discipline

• The ability to work independently

• A results-driven mindset



Experience in health, wellness, education, SaaS, coaching, subscriptions, or B2C sales is a plus.



Compensation



$300 USD guaranteed monthly base salary + strong uncapped performance-based commission per successful sale.



This is a revenue-generating role.



We want strong performers to earn significantly more through commission, and there is no intended cap on your earning potential.



The first 20–30 days will be important. We expect the successful candidate to demonstrate that they can effectively handle incoming opportunities and begin converting leads into paying customers.



Working Style



• Fully remote

• Part-time / flexible workload based on incoming leads and scheduled conversations

• You do not need to sit online for 8 hours when there are no leads to handle

• You must, however, be responsive when new leads and opportunities come in

• Follow-up and keeping your pipeline organized are part of the role



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your relevant sales/closing experience

3. What type of leads you have worked with before, cold, warm, or inbound

4. What products or services you have sold

5. Your previous sales results, if available

6. A short voice or video introduction in English



We are looking for someone who can combine genuine empathy with strong sales ability. If you're great at understanding people, building trust, and turning warm conversations into successful sales, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Accountant
description:
We are an Australian financial advisory company seeking a highly capable Offshore Accountant to support our accounting operations. We are looking for someone with solid Australian company experience, strong attention to detail, and advanced hands-on experience using Xero platform. 



This role is ideal for an accountant who is confident working independently, understand Australian business and tax processes, and can deliver accurate, timely, and insightful financial support. 



Key Responsibilities: 

- Structure, manage, and track client or business rebates. 

- Process employee payments, including monthly and fortnightly payroll support. 

- Manage cash flow monitoring and reporting. 

- Perform bank reconciliations and general account reconciliation. 

- Support and coordinate audit requirements and documentation. 

- Manage Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes. 

- Assist with budgeting and forecasting activities. 

- Prepare management reports and provide financial insights. 

- Liaise with internal stakeholders and external parties on tax-related matters. 

- Maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely processing of transactions. 

- Identify process improvements to enhance finance efficiency and accuracy. 



Required Experience and Skills: 

- Proven experience working with Australian companies or within an Australian accounting/finance environment. 

- Strong practical experience using Xero, including reconciliations, AP/AR, reporting, and general ledger management. 

- Experience in payroll processing, including monthly and fortnightly payment cycles. 

- Solid understanding of core accounting processes, including reconciliations, cash flow, payables, and receivables. 

- Experience supporting audits and preparing finance-related documentation. 

- Good understanding of Australian business and finance practices. 

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. 

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. 

- Ability to work remotely, manage deadlines, and maintain confidentiality. 



Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience in a professional services, financial advisory, accounting, or similar Australian business environment. 

- Exposure to Australian tax or compliance-related processes. 

- Accounting qualification, bookkeeping certification, or equivalent relevant experience. 

- Ability to provide financial insights beyond transactional processing. 



What We Are Looking For: 

- Reliable, proactive, and organised. 

- Comfortable working with an Australian team and Australian business standards. 

- Able to take ownership of finance tasks with minimal supervision. 

- Process-driven, accurate, and committed to meeting deadlines.
